status: DRAFT — 11/04 재번역(능동형·확신 어조), 원어민 검수 전

A9.name: 목성·토성 하우스 통과
A9.used_in: 2027 한 해 키워드·분기 표, 5년 연도별 테마

rows.ko: 나를 넓히는 해
rows.en: A Year to Grow Into Yourself
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Growing Yourself
rows.note: keyword는 제목형으로 Title Case 적용 (keyword_alt는 문장형 소문자). 필요시 통일

rows.ko: 내 모습이 넓어지는 해 · 나를 드러내기 좋은 해
rows.en: A year your presence grows · A year to put yourself out there
rows.en_before_tone: A year your presence grows · A good year to show who you are

rows.ko: 나를 드러낼 기회가 늘고 자신감이 자라기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: You get more chances to show who you are, and your confidence grows with them.
rows.en_before_tone: You'll have more chances to show who you are, and your confidence can grow.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 나 자신의 자리에 머무는 시기입니다. 새 자리에서 먼저 인사하거나 미뤄 둔 계획을 꺼내 보이기가 한결 쉬워져요. 눈에 띄는 일이 늘어나도 어색해하기보다 나답게 받아들여 보세요.
rows.en: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, spends time in your self area. Introducing yourself first somewhere new, or finally sharing the plans you'd shelved, comes far more easily now. When the spotlight finds you, own it instead of shying away.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion is staying in your self area. Saying hello first in a new place, or bringing out plans you'd shelved, gets a lot easier. Even if you're more in the spotlight, you might try welcoming it in your own way rather than feeling awkward.

rows.ko: 나를 소개할 자리가 오면 미루지 말고 한 번 나서 보세요.
rows.en: When a chance to introduce yourself comes up, step forward. Don't put it off.
rows.en_before_tone: When a chance to introduce yourself comes, try stepping forward instead of putting it off.

rows.ko: 들뜬 기분에 약속과 일을 한꺼번에 늘리기 쉬우니 하나씩 받는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: Riding high, you're tempted to say yes to too many plans at once. Take them on one at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're in an upbeat mood, it's easy to pile on promises and tasks all at once, so it can help to take them on one at a time.

rows.ko: 내 가치를 키우는 해
rows.en: A Year to Grow Your Worth
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Growing Your Worth

rows.ko: 내 것이 자라는 해 · 쓸 줄 아는 힘이 커지는 해
rows.en: A year your resources grow · A year you learn to make the most of what you have
rows.en_before_tone: A year what's yours grows · A year you learn to use what you have well

rows.ko: 내가 잘하는 것의 값어치를 다시 알아보기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Now you discover what your talents are really worth.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to recognize the value of what you do well.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 돈과 내 것의 자리를 지나며 '나는 무엇을 줄 수 있는가'에 대한 답을 넓혀 줍니다. 내 기술이나 시간에 제값을 매기는 연습이 자연스러워지는 시기예요. 작은 부수입이나 내 재주의 새로운 쓰임새를 발견하는 장면으로 나타나기도 해요.
rows.en: As the planet of expansion moves through your money & possessions area, it broadens your sense of what you have to offer. Charging what your skills and time are worth starts to feel natural, and it shows up as a side income or a fresh way to use one of your talents.
rows.en_before_tone: As the planet of expansion moves through your money & possessions area, it widens your answer to 'What can I offer?' Putting a fair price on your skills and time starts to feel natural. It may also show up as a small side income or a new use for one of your talents.

rows.ko: 내가 가진 기술을 필요로 하는 곳이 보이면 가볍게 제안해 보세요.
rows.en: When you see someone who could use your skills, offer them. No big pitch needed.
rows.en_before_tone: If you see a place that needs your skills, try making a casual offer.

rows.ko: 여유가 느껴질수록 지출도 커지기 쉬우니 큰 구매는 한 번 더 따져 보는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: A thicker wallet can make you eager to spend more, so think twice before any big purchase.
rows.en_before_tone: The more comfortable you feel, the easier it is to spend more, so it's worth thinking twice before big purchases.

rows.ko: 배우고 말하는 해
rows.en: A Year of Learning and Speaking Up
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Learning and Speaking

rows.ko: 배움이 넓어지는 해 · 가까운 대화가 힘이 되는 해
rows.en: A year your learning branches out · A year good conversations carry you
rows.en_before_tone: A year your learning widens · A year close conversations give you strength

rows.ko: 짧은 배움과 가까운 대화가 힘이 되는 때예요.
rows.en: Quick lessons and good talks with people close to you lift your spirits.
rows.en_before_tone: Short bursts of learning and close conversations give you strength.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 배움과 말의 자리에 머물러 호기심이 커지는 시기입니다. 짧은 강의, 글쓰기, 가까운 사람과의 대화가 생각보다 큰 문을 열어 줘요. 동네를 오가거나 가까운 곳에 다니며 새 정보를 얻는 일도 늘어나기 쉬워요.
rows.en: With the planet of expansion in your learning & communication area, your curiosity is wide awake. A short course, some writing, or a chat with someone close opens bigger doors than you expect. Even everyday errands around the neighborhood bring you useful information.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion stays in your learning & communication area, and your curiosity grows. Short courses, writing, and talks with people close to you can open bigger doors than you expect. You may also pick up new information more often as you get around your neighborhood or nearby places.

rows.ko: 관심 가는 짧은 수업이나 모임이 보이면 한 번 들어가 보세요.
rows.en: When a short class or meetup catches your eye, drop in.
rows.en_before_tone: If a short class or group catches your interest, try dropping in.

rows.ko: 이것저것 동시에 시작하기 쉬우니 끝까지 해 볼 한 가지를 먼저 정해 두세요.
rows.en: You'll be tempted to start five things at once. Pick the one you'll actually finish, and start there.
rows.en_before_tone: It's easy to start several things at once, so it can help to choose one thing you'll see through first.

rows.ko: 뿌리를 넓히는 해
rows.en: A Year to Widen Your Roots
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Widening Your Roots

rows.ko: 집과 마음이 넓어지는 해 · 돌아올 자리가 커지는 해
rows.en: A year your home life opens up · A year your safe place gets bigger
rows.en_before_tone: A year your home and heart open up · A year your place to come home to grows

rows.ko: 집과 가족, 마음 둘 곳이 넓어지기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Home, family, and your safe spaces grow roomier and warmer.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time for home, family, and the places your heart rests to expand.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 집과 마음의 뿌리 자리에 들어와 쉴 곳을 넓혀 주는 시기예요. 생활 공간을 손보는 일이나 가족과 보내는 시간이 마음을 든든하게 채워 줍니다. 돌아갈 곳이 단단해지면 바깥일을 대하는 마음도 한결 느긋해져요.
rows.en: The planet of expansion moves into your home & roots area, giving you more room to rest and recharge. Fixing up your place or spending time with family leaves you feeling full and secure. With home on solid ground, you meet the outside world with far more ease.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion enters your home & roots area, widening your space to rest. Fixing up your living space or spending time with family can leave your heart feeling full and secure. When the place you return to feels solid, you can face the outside world more calmly too.

rows.ko: 내가 편히 쉬는 공간을 한 곳 정해 정성껏 가꿔 보세요.
rows.en: Choose one spot where you truly unwind, and give it some love.
rows.en_before_tone: You might choose one space where you truly relax and care for it with attention.

rows.ko: 집 관련 큰 결정은 기분보다 현실 조건을 먼저 확인한 뒤 움직이는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: Before any big decision about where you live, weigh the practical facts first, then check in with your gut.
rows.en_before_tone: For big decisions about your home, it's wise to check the practical conditions first rather than going by your mood.

rows.ko: 즐거움이 돌아오는 해
rows.en: A Year Joy Comes Back
rows.en_before_tone: A Year Joy Returns

rows.ko: 좋아하는 일이 커지는 해 · 마음껏 즐겨 보는 해
rows.en: A year to make more room for what you love · A year to enjoy yourself fully
rows.en_before_tone: A year what you love grows · A year to enjoy to your heart's content

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것을 다시 즐기고 만들기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: You return to enjoying and making the things you love.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to enjoy and create the things you love again.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 즐거움과 창작의 자리를 비추는 시기입니다. 미뤄 둔 취미나 만들고 싶던 것을 시작하기에 마음이 가벼워져요. 설레는 일이 늘어나는 만큼 나를 웃게 하는 것이 무엇인지 알아보기 좋습니다.
rows.en: This year the planet of expansion lights up your joy & creativity area. Picking up a hobby you'd put off, or making the thing you've been dreaming about, suddenly feels easy. With more to look forward to, notice what truly makes you smile.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion lights up your joy & creativity area. Starting a hobby you'd put off, or something you've wanted to make, feels lighter. With more things to look forward to, it's a good time to discover what really makes you smile.

rows.ko: 오래 미뤄 둔 취미 하나를 이번에는 직접 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: Take that hobby you've been putting off for ages and start it this time.
rows.en_before_tone: This time, you might pick one hobby you've put off for a long time and actually start it.

rows.ko: 재미에 빠져 쉬는 시간까지 다 쓰지 않도록 즐거움에도 끝나는 시간을 정해 두세요.
rows.en: Don't let fun swallow all your downtime. Even good times need a stopping point.
rows.en_before_tone: So fun doesn't eat up all your rest time, it can help to give your fun an end time too.

rows.ko: 일상을 가꾸는 해
rows.en: A Year to Tend Your Days
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Tending Your Days

rows.ko: 하루가 단단해지는 해 · 몸과 일의 리듬이 좋아지는 해
rows.en: A year your days get steadier · A year your work and body find a better rhythm
rows.en_before_tone: A year your days get sturdier · A year the rhythm of body and work improves

rows.ko: 매일의 일과 루틴이 한결 수월해지기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Your daily tasks and routines run much more smoothly.
rows.en_before_tone: Daily tasks and routines can get noticeably easier.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 매일의 일과 몸 관리 자리에 머무는 시기예요. 일하는 방식을 손보거나 새 루틴을 들이기에 힘이 실립니다. 작은 습관 하나가 하루의 리듬을 바꾸는 장면을 만날 수 있어요.
rows.en: While the planet of expansion travels through your daily routines area, covering everyday work and how you care for your body, you gain momentum to rework how you do things or add a new routine. One small habit reshapes the whole rhythm of your day.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion stays in your daily routines area, covering everyday work and caring for your body. You may find extra energy for reworking how you work or bringing in a new routine. You may see one small habit change the whole rhythm of your day.

rows.ko: 일을 덜어 줄 도구나 방법이 보이면 미루지 말고 바로 써 보세요.
rows.en: Spot a tool or trick that lightens your load? Start using it right away.
rows.en_before_tone: If you spot a tool or method that lightens your load, try it right away instead of putting it off.

rows.ko: 할 수 있다는 마음에 업무를 너무 많이 받기 쉬우니 거절할 몫도 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Feeling capable, you're tempted to take on more than you should. Leave yourself room to say no.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel like you can handle it, it's easy to take on too much work, so it's okay to leave room to say no.

rows.ko: 함께 넓어지는 해
rows.en: A Year to Grow Together
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Growing Together

rows.ko: 곁의 사람과 넓어지는 해 · 좋은 짝을 만나는 해
rows.en: A year you grow alongside the people next to you · A year to find a good partner
rows.en_before_tone: A year you grow with the people beside you · A year to meet a good partner

rows.ko: 좋은 동료나 파트너가 힘이 되어 주기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Good colleagues and partners become a real source of support.
rows.en_before_tone: Good colleagues or partners can be a real support.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 가까운 일대일 관계의 자리를 지나는 시기입니다. 함께 일할 사람, 믿고 의논할 사람이 곁에 생기기 쉬워요. 혼자 하던 일을 둘이 나누면서 길이 넓어지는 장면이 찾아오기도 합니다.
rows.en: The planet of expansion passes through your one-on-one relationships area. People to work with, and people you can trust for advice, step into your life. Share what you used to carry alone, and new paths open up.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion moves through your one-on-one relationships area. People to work with and people you can trust for advice are likely to show up. By sharing what you used to do alone, you may find your path widening.

rows.ko: 함께하자는 제안이 오면 조건을 살펴보고 가볍게 대화를 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: When someone suggests teaming up, look over the terms and start an easygoing conversation.
rows.en_before_tone: If someone offers to team up, you might look over the terms and start an easy conversation.

rows.ko: 상대에게 맞추느라 내 몫의 약속까지 늘리지 않도록 할 수 있는 만큼만 약속하세요.
rows.en: Don't overcommit just to keep the other person happy. Promise only what you can deliver.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than stretching your own commitments to fit the other person, it's okay to promise only as much as you can do.

rows.ko: 깊이 나누는 해
rows.en: A Year of Sharing Deeply

rows.ko: 깊은 믿음이 커지는 해 · 함께 쌓는 것이 늘어나는 해
rows.en: A year of deeper trust · A year to build more together
rows.en_before_tone: A year deep trust grows · A year what you build together grows

rows.ko: 믿는 사람과 깊이 나누고 도움을 주고받기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Open up to people you trust, and let help flow both ways.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to share deeply with people you trust and to give and receive help.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 깊은 유대와 함께 나누는 자원의 자리에 머무는 시기예요. 속 이야기를 나눌 사람이 생기거나, 누군가의 도움이 뜻밖에 힘이 되기 쉽습니다. 혼자 쥐고 있던 것을 내려놓을수록 오히려 채워지는 경험을 할 수 있어요.
rows.en: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, settles into your deep bonds area, which covers shared resources too. You find someone you can truly open up to, or help arrives from an unexpected place. The more you release what you've been holding on your own, the more replenished you feel.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion stays in your deep bonds area, where shared resources live. Someone you can open up to may appear, or someone's help may turn out to be a surprising source of strength. The more you let go of what you've been holding alone, the more you may find yourself filled up.

rows.ko: 도움을 받을 기회가 오면 사양하기보다 고맙게 받아 보세요.
rows.en: When someone offers you a favor, accept with gratitude instead of waving it off.
rows.en_before_tone: When a chance to receive help comes, you might try accepting it gratefully rather than turning it down.

rows.ko: 함께 쓰는 돈이나 약속은 좋은 분위기일수록 조건을 글로 남겨 두는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: With shared money or agreements, put the terms in writing, especially while everyone's getting along.
rows.en_before_tone: With shared money or agreements, the better the mood, the more it helps to put the terms in writing.

rows.ko: 멀리 보는 해
rows.en: A Year to Look Further
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Looking Further

rows.ko: 세상이 넓어지는 해 · 배움으로 멀리 가는 해
rows.en: A year your world gets bigger · A year learning takes you far

rows.ko: 여행과 깊은 배움으로 시야가 넓어지기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Travel and deeper study broaden your horizons.
rows.en_before_tone: Travel and deep learning can widen your view.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 넓은 배움과 여행의 자리를 비추는 시기입니다. 낯선 곳에 가 보거나 오래 공부할 주제를 정하기에 마음이 열려요. 다른 생각을 가진 사람과의 대화가 내 기준을 넓혀 주기도 합니다.
rows.en: The planet of expansion lights up your higher learning & travel area. You feel more open to exploring somewhere new or committing to a subject you'll study for years. Conversations with people who see things differently stretch your own point of view, too.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion lights up your higher learning & travel area. Your heart opens to visiting unfamiliar places or choosing a subject to study for the long haul. Conversations with people who think differently can also widen your own frame of reference.

rows.ko: 오래전부터 가 보고 싶던 곳이나 배우고 싶던 분야가 있다면 일정부터 잡아 보세요.
rows.en: If there's a place you've always wanted to go or a subject you've longed to learn, put a date on the calendar.
rows.en_before_tone: If there's a place you've long wanted to visit or a field you've wanted to learn, start by putting it on the calendar.

rows.ko: 큰 그림에 마음이 앞설 때는 지금 할 수 있는 첫걸음 하나로 좁혀 보세요.
rows.en: When the big picture runs away with you, bring it back to one first step you can take today.
rows.en_before_tone: When the big picture gets ahead of you, you might narrow it down to one first step you can take now.

rows.ko: 일이 넓어지는 해
rows.en: A Year Your Work Expands

rows.ko: 일의 무대가 커지는 해 · 해 온 일이 드러나는 해
rows.en: A year you step onto a bigger stage at work · A year your hard work gets noticed
rows.en_before_tone: A year your stage at work gets bigger · A year your past work gets noticed

rows.ko: 일에서 인정받거나 새 역할이 들어오기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Your work earns recognition, and new roles come within reach.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time for recognition at work or a new role to come your way.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 커리어와 사회적 역할의 자리에 머무는 시기예요. 해 온 일이 눈에 띄거나, 새로운 제안이 들어올 수 있습니다. 회의에서 의견을 내거나 결과물을 보여 줄 때 반응이 한결 좋아지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, spends time in your career area, where your public role lives. Your past work finally gets noticed, and new offers start to arrive. Speak up in meetings and show what you've done: people respond well.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion stays in your career area, the place of your role in the world. The work you've done may get noticed, or new offers may come in. When you speak up in meetings or show your results, people may respond more warmly.

rows.ko: 맡아 보고 싶은 역할이 있다면 이번에는 먼저 손을 들어 보세요.
rows.en: If there's a role you've had your eye on, raise your hand first this time.
rows.en_before_tone: If there's a role you'd like to take on, you might try raising your hand first this time.

rows.ko: 기회가 몰릴 때는 다 받기보다 내 방향과 맞는 것부터 고르는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: When opportunities pour in, don't grab them all. Start with the ones that fit where you're headed.
rows.en_before_tone: When opportunities pile up, it can help to choose the ones that fit your direction rather than taking them all.

rows.ko: 사람이 늘어나는 해
rows.en: A Year Your Circle Grows
rows.tone_reason: 직역투 'A Year of More People' → 자연스러운 라벨
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of More People

rows.ko: 좋은 사람이 모이는 해 · 함께할 목표가 생기는 해
rows.en: A year good people gather around you · A year you find goals to share
rows.en_before_tone: A year good people gather · A year shared goals appear

rows.ko: 좋은 사람들과 모임이 미래 목표에 힘이 되어 주기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Good people and groups help carry you toward your future goals.
rows.en_before_tone: Good people and groups can support your future goals.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 사람들과 공동체의 자리를 지나는 시기입니다. 뜻이 맞는 모임이나 새로운 인연이 다음 목표로 가는 길을 열어 주기 쉬워요. 혼자 품던 계획을 꺼내 놓았을 때 도와주겠다는 사람이 나타나기도 합니다.
rows.en: With the planet of expansion moving through your community & future area, like-minded groups and new connections clear a path to your next goal. Share a plan you've been keeping to yourself, and someone steps up to help.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion moves through your community & future area. Like-minded groups or new connections can open the way to your next goal. When you share a plan you'd kept to yourself, someone may step up to help.

rows.ko: 관심 있는 모임이나 커뮤니티가 있다면 한 번 얼굴을 비쳐 보세요.
rows.en: If there's a group or community you've been curious about, show up once and see.
rows.en_before_tone: If there's a group or community you're curious about, try showing up.

rows.ko: 모임과 약속이 늘어나는 만큼 혼자 쉬는 날도 달력에 먼저 적어 두세요.
rows.en: As your social calendar fills, block off solo rest days first.
rows.en_before_tone: As gatherings and plans increase, it can help to mark some days to rest alone on your calendar first.

rows.ko: 안으로 채우는 해
rows.en: A Year to Fill Up From Within
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Filling Up Within

rows.ko: 쉼으로 채우는 해 · 마음을 돌보는 해
rows.en: A year rest refills you · A year to look after yourself
rows.en_before_tone: A year rest fills you up · A year to care for your heart

rows.ko: 겉보다 안을 채우고 쉬어 가기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Rest and recharge on the inside rather than chasing outer results.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to fill yourself from the inside and rest.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 쉼과 내면의 자리에 머무는 조용한 시기예요. 바깥 성과는 덜 보여도 마음을 정리하고 다음 흐름을 준비하는 힘이 자랍니다. 혼자 걷는 시간이나 기록하는 시간이 생각보다 큰 위로가 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: With the planet of expansion in your rest & inner life area, you enter a quieter season. Little shows on the outside, but inside, you're sorting through your feelings and preparing for what comes next. Solo walks or time with a journal comfort you more than you expect.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion stays in your rest & inner life area, a quiet season. Even if outer results are less visible, your ability to sort through your feelings and prepare for what's next grows. Time spent walking alone or journaling may comfort you more than you'd expect.

rows.ko: 하루 중 혼자만의 조용한 시간을 정해 두고 지켜 보세요.
rows.en: Set aside a little quiet time each day just for you, and guard it.
rows.en_before_tone: Try setting aside some quiet time just for yourself each day, and protecting it.

rows.ko: 쉬는 것이 길어져 해야 할 일까지 흐려지지 않도록 작은 마감 하나는 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Don't let rest drift on until your to-dos blur. Keep at least one small deadline on the books.
rows.en_before_tone: So rest doesn't stretch on until your to-dos blur, it can help to keep one small deadline in place.

rows.ko: 나를 다시 세우는 해
rows.en: A Year to Rebuild Yourself
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Rebuilding Yourself

rows.ko: 나를 단단히 하는 해 · 내 기준을 세우는 해
rows.en: A year to stand on firmer ground · A year to set your own standards
rows.en_before_tone: A year of firming up who you are · A year of setting your own standards

rows.ko: 나를 보여주는 방식과 책임을 다시 세우는 때예요.
rows.en: Rethink how you show up and what you're willing to take on.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to rebuild how you present yourself and what you take responsibility for.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 나 자신의 자리에 들어와 '나는 어떤 사람으로 서고 싶은가'를 묻는 시기입니다. 맡는 일이 늘고 몸과 마음이 무겁게 느껴지는 날도 있을 수 있어요. 그만큼 나에게 맞지 않는 모습을 덜어 내고 단단한 모습을 고르기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, moves into your self area and asks, 'Who do I want to be?' You take on more, and some days you feel the weight in body and mind. Meet it head-on: this is your chance to drop what doesn't fit and grow into a stronger, steadier you.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility enters your self area and asks, 'What kind of person do I want to be?' You may take on more, and some days your body and mind may feel heavy. That also makes it a good time to let go of what doesn't fit you and choose a sturdier version of yourself.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 남의 기대보다 내 기준으로 서는 힘이 남아요.
rows.en: When this season is behind you, you stand on your own terms instead of living up to other people's expectations.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll be left with the strength to stand by your own standards rather than others' expectations.

rows.ko: 모든 일을 혼자 증명하려 하기보다 해야 할 일을 작게 나눠 하나씩 끝내 보세요.
rows.en: You don't have to prove everything single-handedly. Break your tasks into small pieces and check them off one by one.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than trying to prove everything on your own, you might break your tasks into small pieces and finish them one by one.

rows.ko: 살림의 바탕을 세우는 해
rows.en: A Year to Build Your Financial Base
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Building Your Financial Base

rows.ko: 내 것의 기준을 세우는 해 · 살림을 단단히 하는 해
rows.en: A year to define what's worth it to you · A year to put your finances on solid ground
rows.en_before_tone: A year of setting standards for what's yours · A year of steadying your household

rows.ko: 돈 쓰는 기준과 내 가치를 차분히 점검하는 때입니다.
rows.en: Take an honest look at your spending habits and your own worth.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to calmly review how you spend and what you're worth.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 돈과 내 것의 자리를 지나는 시기예요. 지출과 수입을 꼼꼼히 들여다봐야 하는 일이 늘고, 여유가 빠듯하게 느껴질 수 있습니다. 대신 무엇에 돈과 시간을 쓰는지 기준이 분명해지는 때이기도 해요.
rows.en: The planet of responsibility passes through your money & possessions area. You keep a closer eye on what comes in and goes out, and money feels tighter for a while. In return, you get crystal clear about where your money and time truly belong.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility is moving through your money & possessions area. You may need to look closely at spending and income more often, and things may feel tight. In return, it's a time when your standards for where your money and time go become clear.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 흔들려도 버틸 수 있는 생활의 기준이 남습니다.
rows.en: What you walk away with: money habits that hold steady even when life gets shaky.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have everyday guidelines that keep you steady even when life feels shaky.

rows.ko: 한 번에 다 바꾸려 하기보다 한 달 지출을 적어 보는 일부터 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: Don't try to overhaul everything at once. Start by tracking your spending for a single month.
rows.en_before_tone: Instead of changing everything at once, you might start by writing down one month of spending.

rows.ko: 말과 배움을 다지는 해

rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Grounding Your Words and Learning

rows.en_before_tone: A year of refining how you speak · A year of steadily building your learning

rows.ko: 배움과 말에 무게가 실리고 꼼꼼함이 필요한 때예요.
rows.en: Your words and studies carry more weight, so the details matter.
rows.en_before_tone: Learning and words carry more weight, and paying attention to details matters.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 배움과 말의 자리에 머무는 시기입니다. 자격 공부나 문서 작업처럼 차근차근 쌓아야 하는 일이 늘어나기 쉬워요. 말 한마디가 무겁게 느껴질 때도 있지만, 그만큼 생각을 정리해 전하는 힘이 길러집니다.
rows.en: With the planet of responsibility in your learning & communication area, you face work that builds step by step, like studying for a certification or handling paperwork. Every word feels weighty at times, and that's exactly how you learn to organize your thoughts and say them clearly.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility stays in your learning & communication area. Work that builds step by step, like studying for a certification or paperwork, is likely to increase. rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 꾸준히 쌓은 공부와 신뢰받는 말이 남아요.
rows.en: When this transit ends, you hold solid knowledge and a voice people trust.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have steady learning and words people trust.

rows.ko: 완벽하게 준비될 때까지 기다리기보다 매일 조금씩 하는 분량을 정해 두세요.
rows.en: Don't wait until you feel perfectly ready. Set a small daily amount and chip away at it.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than waiting until you're perfectly ready, it can help to set a small amount to do each day.

rows.en_before_tone: A year of strengthening home and heart · A year of building your place to come home to

rows.ko: 집과 가족 일에 책임이 늘고 생활의 바탕을 다지는 때입니다.
rows.en: You shoulder more at home and with family as you shore up the foundations of your life.
rows.en_before_tone: A time when responsibilities at home and with family grow, and you firm up the foundation of your life.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 집과 마음의 뿌리 자리에 들어오는 시기예요. 이사나 집안일, 가족을 챙기는 일처럼 생활의 바탕을 손볼 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 무겁게 느껴질 수 있지만 오래 쓸 기반을 새로 다지는 과정이기도 해요.
rows.en: As Saturn, the planet of responsibility, enters your home & roots area, the basics of your life call for attention: a move, chores, or caring for family. It feels like a lot, and you're laying a foundation that serves you for years. Trust the work.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility enters your home & roots area. Things that touch the base of your life, like moving, housework, or looking after family, are likely to come up. It may feel heavy, but it's also a process of laying a new foundation you'll use for a long time.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 마음 놓고 돌아올 수 있는 생활의 터가 남습니다.
rows.en: On the other side of this, you have a home base where you can truly relax.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have a home base you can return to with peace of mind.

rows.ko: 집과 가족 일을 혼자 다 떠안기보다 나눌 수 있는 몫을 말로 정해 보세요.
rows.en: Don't shoulder all the home and family work alone. Talk it out and agree on who handles what.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than carrying all the home and family work alone, it can help to talk it through and agree on the parts others can share.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것을 다지는 해

rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Deepening What You Love

rows.ko: 좋아하는 일을 깊게 하는 해 · 즐거움에 공을 들이는 해
rows.en: A year to go all in on what you love · A year to put real effort into your joy
rows.en_before_tone: A year of going deep with what you love · A year of putting effort into joy

rows.ko: 즐거움보다 꾸준함이 필요하고, 좋아하는 것이 깊어지는 때예요.
rows.en: Commitment matters more than fun now, and your passions run deeper.
rows.en_before_tone: Consistency matters more than fun, and what you love grows deeper.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 즐거움과 창작의 자리를 지나는 시기입니다. 가볍게 즐기던 일에도 노력이 들고, 재미가 덜하다고 느낄 수 있어요. 대신 정말 좋아하는 것 하나를 골라 꾸준히 다듬으면 실력으로 남기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: The planet of responsibility moves through your joy & creativity area. Even pastimes you once did just for fun start to take effort and lose some sparkle. Choose one thing you truly love and keep polishing it, and this season turns it into real skill.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility moves through your joy & creativity area. Even things you used to enjoy lightly may take effort, and they may feel less fun. But if you choose one thing you truly love and keep refining it, it's a good time for it to become real skill.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 오래 이어 온 취미나 작업이 나만의 결과물로 남아요.
rows.en: The payoff: a hobby or project you've stuck with becomes something that's truly your own.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, a hobby or project you've kept up can become something that's truly yours.

rows.ko: 즐거움을 숙제로 만들지 않도록 잘하려는 마음보다 이어 가는 데 목표를 두세요.
rows.en: Keep joy from turning into homework. Aim to keep going, not to be great at it.
rows.en_before_tone: So joy doesn't turn into homework, it can help to aim for keeping it going rather than being good at it.

rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Building Routines

rows.ko: 하루의 틀을 잡는 해 · 일과 몸의 리듬을 세우는 해

rows.en_before_tone: A year of shaping your days · A year of setting the rhythm of work and body

rows.ko: 매일의 일과 몸 관리 루틴을 다시 짜는 때입니다.
rows.en: Reset your daily schedule and how you look after your body.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to rework your daily tasks and how you care for your body.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 매일의 일과 몸 관리 자리에 머무는 시기예요. 업무가 늘고 피로가 쉽게 쌓여 지금의 방식을 돌아볼 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 잠, 식사, 쉬는 시간을 하나씩 정돈하면 오래 버틸 리듬이 만들어져요.
rows.en: While the planet of responsibility stays in your daily routines area, covering everyday work and caring for your body, your workload grows and fatigue piles up fast, pushing you to rethink how you do things. Sort out sleep, meals, and breaks one at a time, and you build a rhythm you can sustain.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility stays in your daily routines area, covering everyday work and caring for your body. With more work and tiredness piling up easily, you may find reasons to rethink how you do things. If you sort out sleep, meals, and rest one at a time, you can build a rhythm that lasts.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 바쁜 날에도 무너지지 않는 나만의 루틴이 남습니다.

rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have routines of your own that hold up even on busy days.

rows.ko: 피곤할수록 더 버티기보다 하루에 쉬는 시간 하나를 먼저 정해 두세요.
rows.en: When you're worn out, don't just push harder. Schedule one real break into each day first.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're tired, rather than pushing through even harder, it can help to set one rest break a day first.

rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Firming Up Relationships

rows.ko: 관계의 약속을 세우는 해 · 곁의 사람과 단단해지는 해
rows.en: A year to get clear on what you promise each other · A year to grow closer and steadier with your people
rows.en_before_tone: A year of making clear agreements in relationships · A year of growing solid with those beside you

rows.ko: 가까운 관계의 약속과 책임을 다시 살펴보는 때예요.
rows.en: Take a fresh look at the promises and responsibilities in your close relationships.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to look again at the promises and responsibilities in close relationships.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 가까운 일대일 관계의 자리를 지나는 시기입니다. 동료나 파트너와의 약속, 서로 기대하는 몫이 또렷하게 보이기 쉬워요. 불편한 이야기를 꺼내야 할 때도 있지만, 그만큼 관계의 기준이 분명해지는 때입니다.
rows.en: The planet of responsibility travels through your one-on-one relationships area. Agreements with colleagues or partners, and what each of you expects, come into sharp focus. Bring up the awkward topics: that's how the ground rules between you become clear.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility moves through your one-on-one relationships area. Agreements with colleagues or partners, and what you each expect, are likely to come into sharp focus. There may be times you need to raise uncomfortable topics, but that's how the ground rules of a relationship become clear.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 서로의 몫이 분명한, 믿을 수 있는 관계가 남아요.
rows.en: Once you're through this, you have relationships you can count on, where everyone knows their part.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have trustworthy relationships where each person's part is clear.

rows.ko: 서운함을 오래 쌓아 두기보다 바라는 것을 한 가지씩 담담하게 말해 보세요.
rows.en: Don't let hurt feelings stack up. Calmly name what you'd like, one thing at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than letting hurt feelings pile up, you might try calmly saying what you'd like, one thing at a time.

rows.ko: 나눔의 기준을 세우는 해

rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Setting Rules for Sharing

rows.ko: 깊은 관계를 정리하는 해 · 함께 쓰는 것의 기준을 세우는 해

rows.en_before_tone: A year of sorting out deep relationships · A year of setting rules for what you share

rows.ko: 함께 쓰는 돈과 깊은 관계의 기준을 정리하는 때입니다.
rows.en: Sort out shared money and the ground rules of your closest bonds.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to sort out shared money and the ground rules of deep relationships.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 깊은 유대와 함께 나누는 자원의 자리에 머무는 시기예요. 대출·보험·공동 비용처럼 함께 얽힌 문제를 정리할 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 마음 깊은 이야기도 가볍게 넘기기 어려워지지만, 그만큼 믿음의 기준이 단단해져요.
rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, settles into your deep bonds area, which also covers shared resources. Tangled joint matters, like loans, insurance, or shared bills, call for sorting out. Deep, personal talks get harder to brush aside, and your trust in each other grows sturdier for it.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility stays in your deep bonds area, where shared resources live. Heartfelt conversations become harder to brush off, but your foundation of trust grows sturdier for it.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 무엇을 누구와 나눌지에 대한 분명한 기준이 남습니다.
rows.en: When this season wraps up, you know exactly what you share, and with whom.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have clear standards for what to share and with whom.

rows.ko: 얽힌 일을 한 번에 풀려 하기보다 목록으로 적어 하나씩 정리해 보세요.
rows.en: Don't try to untangle it all in one go. List everything and work through it item by item.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than untangling everything at once, you might write it all out as a list and sort through it one by one.

rows.ko: 믿음을 다지는 해
rows.en: A Year to Ground Your Beliefs
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Firming Up Your Beliefs

rows.ko: 내 생각을 단단히 하는 해 · 배움을 끝까지 해 보는 해
rows.en: A year to firm up what you think · A year to see your studies through
rows.en_before_tone: A year of steadying your thinking · A year of seeing your learning through

rows.ko: 공부와 신념에 깊이를 더하고 방향을 다지는 때예요.
rows.en: Deepen your studies and beliefs, and settle on a direction.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to deepen your studies and beliefs and settle on a direction.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 넓은 배움과 신념의 자리를 지나는 시기입니다. 긴 공부나 자격 과정처럼 시간이 드는 배움에 무게가 실리기 쉬워요. 내가 무엇을 믿고 어디로 가는지 묻는 시간이 길어져도, 그 답은 오래 쓸 지도가 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: The planet of responsibility moves through your higher learning & travel area, where your beliefs live too. Learning that takes time, like a long course of study or a certification program, takes on more weight. You spend a while asking what you believe and where you're headed, and the answers become a map you use for years.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility moves through your higher learning & travel area, where beliefs live too. Learning that takes time, like long-term study or a certification program, is likely to carry more weight. Even if you spend a while asking what you believe and where you're headed, the answer can become a map you use for years.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 남의 말에 덜 흔들리는 나만의 방향이 남아요.
rows.en: After this transit, you carry a sense of direction that other people's opinions can't easily knock off course.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have a direction of your own that others' words can't shake as easily.

rows.ko: 답을 빨리 내려 하기보다 한 분야를 정해 꾸준히 파고드는 쪽을 택해 보세요.
rows.en: Don't rush to an answer. Pick one field and keep digging into it.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than rushing to an answer, you might choose one field and dig into it steadily.

rows.ko: 자리를 굳히는 해
rows.en: A Year to Secure Your Place
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Securing Your Place

rows.ko: 일의 자리를 다지는 해 · 책임이 커지는 해
rows.en: A year to solidify your place at work · A year your responsibilities grow
rows.en_before_tone: A year of firming up your place at work · A year your responsibilities grow

rows.ko: 일의 책임이 커지고 그동안의 결과를 점검받는 때입니다.
rows.en: Your responsibilities at work grow, and your track record gets a closer look.
rows.en_before_tone: Your responsibilities at work grow, and what you've done so far gets reviewed.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 커리어와 사회적 역할의 자리에 들어오는 시기예요. 맡는 역할이 무거워지고, 그동안 해 온 일의 결과를 돌아볼 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 버거운 날도 있겠지만 인정받을 실력을 차곡차곡 굳히는 때이기도 해요.
rows.en: With the planet of responsibility entering your career area, where your public role lives, your role grows heavier and you take stock of what you've achieved so far. Some days feel like a lot, but you're steadily building the kind of skill that earns recognition.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility enters your career area, the place of your role in the world. Your role may get heavier, and you'll likely have reason to look back at the results of your work so far. Some days may feel like a lot, but it's also a time to steadily build skills that earn recognition.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 쉽게 흔들리지 않는 일의 자리와 신뢰가 남습니다.
rows.en: When this season is done, you stand on solid footing at work, with the trust that comes with it.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have a place at work and a level of trust that don't shake easily.

rows.ko: 모든 기대에 응하기보다 꼭 지켜야 할 일의 우선순위를 먼저 적어 두세요.
rows.en: You can't meet every expectation. Write down the few priorities you truly need to protect.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than meeting every expectation, it can help to first write down the priorities you truly need to keep.

rows.ko: 사람을 고르는 해
rows.en: A Year to Choose Your People
rows.en_before_tone: A Year of Choosing Your People

rows.ko: 곁의 사람을 추리는 해 · 오래 갈 사람을 아는 해
rows.en: A year to narrow your circle · A year to learn who's in it for the long haul
rows.en_before_tone: A year of narrowing your circle · A year of knowing who'll stay

rows.ko: 사람들과의 관계와 미래 목표를 현실적으로 다듬는 때예요.
rows.en: Get realistic about your friendships and your goals for the future.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to realistically shape your relationships and future goals.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 사람들과 공동체의 자리를 지나는 시기입니다. 모임에서 맡는 역할이 늘거나, 어떤 관계가 나에게 맞는지 돌아보기 쉬워요. 넓기보다 깊은 관계, 막연하기보다 구체적인 목표가 남는 때입니다.
rows.en: The planet of responsibility passes through your community & future area. You take on more roles in your groups, or you start asking which relationships truly suit you. Right now, depth beats breadth in friendship, and concrete goals beat vague ones.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility moves through your community & future area. You may take on more roles in groups, or find yourself reflecting on which relationships suit you. It's a time when deep relationships matter more than wide ones, and concrete goals more than vague ones.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 오래 함께할 사람들과 현실적인 목표가 남아요.
rows.en: What stays with you afterward: people who stick around and goals you can actually reach.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have realistic goals and people who'll stay with you for the long run.

rows.ko: 모든 모임을 지키려 하기보다 에너지를 쓸 곳을 몇 군데로 좁혀 보세요.
rows.en: You don't have to keep up with every group. Narrow your energy down to a few that matter.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than trying to keep up with every group, you might narrow down where you spend your energy to just a few places.

rows.ko: 조용히 정리하는 해
rows.en: A Year of Quiet Sorting

rows.ko: 안을 정돈하는 해 · 조용히 힘을 모으는 해
rows.en: A year to tidy up inside · A year to quietly gather your strength
rows.en_before_tone: A year of tidying within · A year of quietly gathering strength

rows.ko: 겉으로 드러나지 않는 정리와 쉼이 필요한 때입니다.
rows.en: Sort things out behind the scenes, and rest.
rows.en_before_tone: A time for quiet sorting and rest that happens out of sight.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 쉼과 내면의 자리에 머무는 조용한 시기예요. 눈에 보이는 성과보다 미뤄 둔 마음과 일을 정리하는 시간이 길어지기 쉽습니다. 답답하게 느껴질 수 있지만 다음 시작을 위한 자리를 비우는 과정이기도 해요.
rows.en: With the planet of responsibility in your rest & inner life area, you enter a quiet season. Instead of visible results, you spend your time working through feelings and tasks you've set aside. It feels stifling at times, but you're clearing space for your next fresh start.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility stays in your rest & inner life area, a quiet season. More time may go to sorting through feelings and tasks you've set aside than to visible results. It may feel stifling, but it's also a process of clearing space for your next beginning.

rows.ko: 이 시기를 지나면 가볍게 새로 시작할 수 있는 비워진 자리가 남습니다.
rows.en: Once it's over, you hold a clean slate and the freedom to begin again, lighter than before.
rows.en_before_tone: Once this season passes, you'll have a cleared space where you can start fresh and light.

rows.ko: 혼자 견디기보다 마음을 털어놓을 사람이나 기록할 공간을 하나 마련해 보세요.
rows.en: Don't tough it out alone. Find one person to confide in, or one place to write it all down.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than enduring it alone, you might find one person to open up to or one place to write things down.

A10.name: 연말·단기 역행
A10.used_in: 연말 월별 표('무엇을 조심할까'), 접힌 근거('왜 그럴까'), 2027 1분기(화성 역행)

rows.ko: 나를 소개하는 말과 첫인상을 한 번 더 다듬기
rows.en: Fine-tune how you introduce yourself and the first impression you make
rows.en_before_tone: Polish how you introduce yourself and your first impression one more time
rows.note: '~하기' 명사형 셀 → 마침표 없는 명령형 구로 처리

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 나 자신의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 나를 드러내는 말을 다시 보게 하는 때예요.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, is retrograde in your self area, asking you to rethink how you describe yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your self area, prompting you to revisit the words you use to show who you are.
rows.note: '생각·말의 별/좋아하는 것·관계의 별/의욕·행동의 별'은 글로서리에 없어 the planet of thought and words / love and relationships / drive and action으로 통일. 글로서리 추가 권장

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 나 자신의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 것처럼 보이는 기간입니다. 내 뜻이 다르게 전해지거나, 스스로 결정을 자꾸 고치고 싶어지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, appears to move backward through your self area. Your meaning doesn't always land the way you intend, and you catch yourself second-guessing your own decisions.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words appears to move backward through your self area. Your meaning may come across differently, or you may keep wanting to revise your own decisions.

rows.ko: 프로필이나 자기소개 글은 올리기 전 하루 묵혀 다시 읽어 보세요.
rows.en: Before you post a new profile or bio, let it sit for a day and read it again.
rows.en_before_tone: Before posting a profile or self-introduction, try letting it sit for a day and reading it again.

rows.ko: 결제·송금 내역과 금액을 한 번 더 확인하기
rows.en: Double-check payments, transfers, and amounts
rows.en_before_tone: Double-check payment and transfer records and amounts

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 돈과 내 것의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 돈 계산과 정산을 다시 보게 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: With the planet of thought and words retrograde in your money & possessions area, the math and the settling-up deserve a second look.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your money & possessions area, prompting you to recheck calculations and settlements.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 돈과 내 것의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간이에요. 금액을 잘못 적거나 환불·정산이 늦어지는 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 지난 지출을 다시 들여다보기에는 오히려 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Mercury is retrograde in your money & possessions area. Typos in amounts and slow refunds or reimbursements crop up more often now. On the bright side, you get a great chance to review what you've been spending.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words is moving backward through your money & possessions area. It's easy to write down the wrong amount, or for refunds and settlements to be delayed. It's actually a good time to look back over past spending.

rows.ko: 이번 달 결제 내역을 한 번 훑어보고 잊고 있던 구독을 정리해 보세요.
rows.en: Skim this month's charges and cancel any subscriptions you forgot you had.
rows.en_before_tone: Try skimming through this month's payments and canceling any subscriptions you'd forgotten about.

rows.ko: 메시지·메일은 보내기 전에 한 번 더 읽기
rows.en: Reread texts and emails before you hit send
rows.en_before_tone: Reread messages and emails once more before sending

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 말과 배움의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 연락과 말을 다시 확인하게 하는 때예요.
rows.en: The planet of thought and words is retrograde in your learning & communication area, so it pays to double-check every message.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your learning & communication area, prompting you to double-check messages and words.

rows.ko: 말과 연락을 맡는 별이 바로 그 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간입니다. 답장이 늦거나 말이 엇갈리고, 짧은 이동 중 일정이 바뀌기 쉬워요. 대신 미뤄 둔 공부나 글을 다시 꺼내 다듬기에는 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: The planet that rules words and messages is retrograde on its own home turf. Replies slow down, wires get crossed, and plans shift while you're out and about. Use the time to dust off studying or writing you'd shelved and polish it up.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet that rules words and messages is moving backward right through its own area. Replies may be slow, wires may get crossed, and plans may change during short trips. On the other hand, it's a good time to bring back study or writing you'd put off and polish it.

rows.ko: 중요한 메시지는 보내기 전 하루 묵혀 보세요.
rows.en: Sleep on important messages before sending them.
rows.en_before_tone: Try letting important messages sit for a day before sending them.

rows.ko: 집·가족 일정과 약속을 한 번 더 확인하기
rows.en: Double-check home and family plans and appointments

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 집과 마음의 뿌리 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 집안의 말과 서류를 다시 보게 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, turns retrograde in your home & roots area, bringing household conversations and paperwork back up for review.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your home & roots area, prompting you to revisit conversations and paperwork at home.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 집과 마음의 뿌리 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간이에요. 가족 사이에 말이 엇갈리거나 집 관련 서류·수리가 늦어지기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: While Mercury is retrograde in your home & roots area, family members talk past each other more easily, and home paperwork or repairs run behind schedule.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words is moving backward through your home & roots area. Family members may misunderstand each other, or home-related paperwork and repairs may be delayed.

rows.ko: 집 관련 계약서나 수리 일정은 날짜와 조건을 다시 확인해 보세요.
rows.en: For leases, contracts, or repair appointments, confirm the dates and terms one more time.
rows.en_before_tone: For home-related contracts or repair schedules, it's worth rechecking the dates and terms.

rows.ko: 들뜬 마음에 한 말이나 약속을 다시 살펴보기
rows.en: Take a second look at anything you said or promised in the heat of excitement
rows.en_before_tone: Look again at words or promises made in an excited mood

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 즐거움과 창작의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 지난 작업을 다시 꺼내게 하는 때예요.
rows.en: The planet of thought and words goes retrograde in your joy & creativity area, pulling old projects back out of the drawer.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your joy & creativity area, prompting you to bring out past projects again.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 즐거움과 창작의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간입니다. 예전에 하던 취미나 작업을 다시 꺼내고 싶어지기 쉬워요. 새로 시작하기보다 지난 작업을 고치고 마무리하기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Mercury is retrograde in your joy & creativity area, and you feel the urge to pick up an old hobby or project again. Instead of starting something new, revise and finish what you already began.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words is moving backward through your joy & creativity area. You may feel like picking up an old hobby or project again. Rather than starting something new, it's a good time to revise and finish past work.

rows.ko: 멈춰 둔 작업 하나를 꺼내 끝까지 마무리해 보세요.
rows.en: Pull out one project you'd put on hold and see it through to the end.
rows.en_before_tone: Try bringing out one project you'd paused and seeing it through to the end.

rows.ko: 업무 메일·일정·지시를 한 번 더 확인하기
rows.en: Double-check work emails, schedules, and instructions

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 매일의 일과 루틴 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 업무 소통을 다시 점검하게 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: With the planet of thought and words retrograde in your daily routines area, work communication needs an extra check.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your daily routines area, prompting you to recheck work communication.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 매일의 일과 루틴 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간이에요. 업무 지시가 엇갈리거나 기기·일정이 꼬이는 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 일하는 방식을 다시 점검하기에는 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: While the planet of thought and words is retrograde in your daily routines area, instructions at work get muddled, and devices or schedules glitch. Use the moment to take stock of how you work.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words is moving backward through your daily routines area. Work instructions may get mixed up, or devices and schedules may get tangled. It's a good time to review how you work.

rows.ko: 하루를 마칠 때 다음 날 일정과 받은 지시를 한 번 정리해 보세요.
rows.en: At the end of each day, jot down tomorrow's schedule and any instructions you were given.
rows.en_before_tone: At the end of each day, you might jot down tomorrow's schedule and any instructions you received.

rows.ko: 가까운 사람과의 약속·합의를 다시 확인하기
rows.en: Reconfirm plans and agreements with the people closest to you
rows.en_before_tone: Reconfirm promises and agreements with people close to you

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 일대일 관계의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 합의와 약속을 다시 확인하게 하는 때예요.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, is retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area, so confirm agreements and promises twice.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your one-on-one relationships area, prompting you to reconfirm agreements and promises.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 가까운 일대일 관계의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간입니다. 같은 말을 서로 다르게 알아듣거나 계약 조건이 다시 오가기 쉬워요. 지난 오해를 차분히 풀어 보기에는 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Mercury goes retrograde in your one-on-one relationships area. You and someone close hear the same words in completely different ways, or contract terms go back and forth again. Calmly clear up old misunderstandings while you can.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words is moving backward through your one-on-one relationships area. You may each hear the same words differently, or contract terms may go back and forth again. It's a good time to calmly clear up past misunderstandings.

rows.ko: 중요한 합의는 대화 뒤 짧게 글로 정리해 서로 확인해 보세요.
rows.en: After an important conversation, write a quick summary of what you agreed on and check it with each other.
rows.en_before_tone: After an important conversation, try writing a short summary of what you agreed and checking it with each other.

rows.ko: 함께 쓰는 돈·서류의 조건을 한 번 더 확인하기
rows.en: Double-check the terms on shared money and paperwork
rows.en_before_tone: Double-check the terms of shared money and documents

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 공유 자원의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 서류와 조건을 다시 보게 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: The planet of thought and words is retrograde in your shared resources area, sending you back to the documents and the fine print.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your area of shared resources, prompting you to revisit documents and terms.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 별이 깊은 유대와 함께 나누는 자원의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간이에요. 대출·보험·정산 같은 서류가 늦어지거나 다시 확인할 일이 생기기 쉽습니다. 오래 묻어 둔 이야기를 다시 꺼내 보기 쉬운 때이기도 해요.
rows.en: With Mercury retrograde in your deep bonds area, which also covers shared resources, paperwork like loans, insurance, or reimbursements runs late or needs another look. Conversations you buried long ago find their way back to the surface, too.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words is moving backward through your deep bonds area, where shared resources live. Paperwork like loans, insurance, or settlements may be delayed or need rechecking. It's also a time when long-buried conversations can easily resurface.

rows.ko: 서명 전에는 조건을 한 줄씩 소리 내어 다시 읽어 보세요.
rows.en: Before you sign anything, read the terms out loud, line by line.
rows.en_before_tone: Before signing, you might read the terms aloud again, line by line.

rows.ko: 여행·출장 일정과 예약을 한 번 더 확인하기
rows.en: Double-check travel plans, work trips, and bookings
rows.en_before_tone: Double-check travel and business trip plans and bookings

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별이 여행과 넓은 배움의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 일정과 예약을 다시 확인하게 하는 때예요.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, turns retrograde in your higher learning & travel area, so reconfirm your plans and reservations.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your higher learning & travel area, prompting you to reconfirm plans and bookings.

rows.en_before_tone: The day before you leave, it can help to recheck your bookings and travel times.

rows.ko: 보고·발표 자료와 업무 결정을 한 번 더 점검하기

rows.en_before_tone: Review reports, presentation materials, and work decisions once more

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your career area, prompting you to review work decisions.

rows.en: While Mercury is retrograde in your career area, where your public role lives, communication with your boss gets crossed, and projects already underway come back for another review. Save any big change of direction for after this period.

rows.ko: 이직·계약 같은 결정은 메모로 남겨 두고 역행이 끝난 뒤 다시 읽어 보세요.

rows.en: Mercury, the planet of thought and words, goes retrograde in your community & future area, so keep a closer eye on group messages.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of thought and words moves backward through your community & future area, prompting you to keep up with group communication.
