rows.en: With the planet of drive and action retrograde in your community & future area, you learn to match your pace with the group.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of drive and action moves backward through your community & future area, helping you match your pace with others on shared work.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동의 별이 사람들과 공동체의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간입니다. 함께하는 일의 속도가 느려지거나 의견 차이가 커지기 쉬워요. 예전에 함께하던 사람들과 미뤄 둔 계획을 다시 다듬기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Mars is retrograde in your community & future area. Group projects slow down, or disagreements widen. Revisit shelved plans with people you used to team up with.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of drive and action is moving backward through your community & future area. Shared work may slow down, or differences of opinion may grow. It's a good time to revisit postponed plans with people you used to work with.

rows.ko: 단체 일은 내 몫을 분명히 정하고 그 이상은 맡지 않도록 해 보세요.
rows.en: In group work, spell out your share clearly and don't take on more than that.
rows.en_before_tone: For group work, try defining your share clearly and not taking on more than that.

rows.ko: 쌓인 짜증을 혼자 삼키지만 말고 풀어 주기
rows.en: Don't just swallow your frustration; find a way to let it out
rows.en_before_tone: Don't just swallow built-up irritation alone; let it out

rows.ko: 의욕·행동의 별이 쉼과 내면의 자리에서 거꾸로 가며 속에 쌓인 기운을 돌보게 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: The planet of drive and action goes retrograde in your rest & inner life area, so tend to the energy that's been building up inside.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of drive and action moves backward through your rest & inner life area, prompting you to tend to the energy building up inside.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동의 별이 쉼과 내면의 자리에서 거꾸로 가는 기간이에요. 이유 없이 기운이 빠지거나 속으로 화가 쌓이기 쉽습니다. 몸을 움직여 마음을 풀고 충분히 쉬어 가기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: While Mars is retrograde in your rest & inner life area, you feel drained for no clear reason, or anger quietly piles up inside. Move your body to clear your head, and rest deeply.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of drive and action is moving backward through your rest & inner life area. You may feel drained for no clear reason, or anger may quietly pile up inside. It's a good time to move your body to ease your mind and get plenty of rest.

rows.ko: 답답할 때는 가볍게 걷거나 몸을 풀어 쌓인 기운을 내보내 보세요.
rows.en: When you feel stuck, take a short walk or stretch it out to release that pent-up energy.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel stuck, a light walk or a stretch can help release the built-up energy.

rows.ko: 가을 끝자락은 관계와 돈의 감각, 그리고 말과 연락을 다시 살펴보는 때입니다. 큰 결정은 서두르기보다 한 번 더 확인하고 움직이기 좋아요.
rows.en: Late fall asks you to take a second look at your relationships, your finances, and the way you communicate. Before any big decision, double-check the details, then move with confidence.
rows.en_before_tone: Late autumn is a time to revisit your sense of relationships and money, along with words and messages. For big decisions, it helps to double-check before you move rather than rushing.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것·관계의 별과 생각·말의 별이 함께 거꾸로 가는 것처럼 보이는 기간이에요.
rows.en: Venus, the planet of love and relationships, and Mercury, the planet of thought and words, both turn retrograde (appear to move backward) during this stretch.
rows.en_before_tone: A period when the planet of love and relationships and the planet of thought and words both appear to move backward.

rows.ko: 새해 초에는 의욕과 추진의 속도가 평소보다 느려지기 쉬워요. 새로 벌이기보다 미뤄 둔 일을 다시 다듬기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Early in the new year, your drive runs slower than usual. Skip the grand launch and return to what you set aside: polish it until it shines.
rows.en_before_tone: Early in the new year, drive and momentum tend to run slower than usual. Rather than starting new things, it's a good time to polish what you'd put off.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동의 별이 석 달 가까이 거꾸로 가는 것처럼 보이는 기간입니다.
rows.en: For nearly three months, the planet of drive and action appears to travel backward across the sky.
rows.en_before_tone: A period of nearly three months when the planet of drive and action appears to move backward.

rows.ko: 나를 표현하고 즐거움을 되찾는 일에 순풍이 부는 흐름입니다. 나다운 모습을 드러내는 시도가 반가운 반응을 얻기 쉬워요.
rows.en: Jupiter supports every move you make to express yourself and rediscover your joy. Let your true self show, and people answer with warmth.
rows.en_before_tone: A tailwind is blowing for expressing yourself and rediscovering joy. Efforts to show who you really are tend to get a warm response.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 자기표현의 별자리인 사자자리를 지나는 때예요.
rows.en: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, moves through Leo, the sign of radiant self-expression.
rows.en_before_tone: A time when the planet of expansion moves through Leo, the sign of self-expression.

rows.ko: 일상과 일하는 방식을 정돈하는 데 힘이 실리는 흐름이에요. 작은 습관과 꼼꼼한 손질이 생각보다 큰 결실로 이어지기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: Putting your days and your way of working in order gets a boost from Jupiter. Small habits and careful finishing touches pay off far more than you expect.
rows.en_before_tone: You'll find extra support for tidying up your daily life and the way you work. Small habits and careful attention can lead to bigger results than you'd expect.

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 정리와 돌봄의 별자리인 처녀자리를 지나는 때입니다.
rows.en: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, tours Virgo, the sign of order and care.
rows.en_before_tone: A time when the planet of expansion moves through Virgo, the sign of order and care.

rows.ko: 새로운 시작을 책임 있게 다져 가는 흐름이 모두에게 이어집니다. 꿈꾸던 방향을 현실의 모양으로 다듬는 시도가 늘어나기 쉬워요.
rows.en: Everyone feels the call to build new beginnings with steadfast commitment. Across the board, people turn long-held dreams into something real and solid.
rows.en_before_tone: There's a shared current, for all of us, toward building new beginnings with care and responsibility. More of us may find ourselves shaping long-held dreams into something real.

rows.ko: 책임의 별과 꿈·영감의 별이 시작의 별자리인 양자리에 함께 머무는 시기예요.
rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, and Neptune, the planet of dreams, share Aries, the sign of beginnings.
rows.en_before_tone: A season when the planet of responsibility and the planet of dreams stay together in Aries, the sign of beginnings.

rows.ko: 배우고 말하고 연결되는 방식이 빠르게 달라지는 흐름입니다. 낯선 도구나 새로운 소통 방식이 뜻밖의 기회를 열어 주기도 해요.
rows.en: The way we learn, talk, and connect is shifting fast. Say yes to unfamiliar tools and new ways of communicating: they open unexpected doors.
rows.en_before_tone: The ways we learn, talk, and connect are changing quickly. Unfamiliar tools or new ways of communicating can open unexpected doors.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 소통과 정보의 별자리인 쌍둥이자리를 오래 지나는 때입니다.
rows.en: Uranus, the planet of change, settles into Gemini, the sign of communication and information, for a long stay.
rows.en_before_tone: A long stretch when the planet of change moves through Gemini, the sign of communication and information.

rows.ko: 생활의 기반과 돈의 감각을 천천히 다지는 흐름이에요. 빠른 성과보다 오래갈 기반을 만드는 일이 빛나기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: You slowly shore up the foundations of your life and your relationship with money. Trust the long game: what you build to last shines brighter than any quick win.
rows.en_before_tone: This is a time for slowly firming up the base of your life and your sense of money. Building foundations that last tends to shine more than quick results.

rows.ko: 책임의 별이 안정과 소유의 별자리인 황소자리를 지나는 때입니다.
rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, makes its way through Taurus, the sign of stability and possessions.
rows.en_before_tone: A time when the planet of responsibility moves through Taurus, the sign of stability and possessions.

rows.ko: 배움과 말에는 책임이 실리고, 넓은 세상을 향한 호기심에는 순풍이 부는 흐름입니다. 공부와 경험을 차근차근 이어 가기 좋아요.
rows.en: Saturn gives your words and studies new weight, while Jupiter fuels your curiosity about the wider world. Keep learning and gathering experiences, one steady step at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: Learning and words carry responsibility, while a tailwind blows for curiosity about the wider world. It's a good time to keep up your studies and experiences step by step.

rows.ko: 책임의 별은 소통의 별자리에, 확장의 별은 탐험의 별자리에 머물며 서로 마주 보는 자리를 이뤄요.
rows.en: Saturn sits in Gemini, the sign of communication, while Jupiter sits in Sagittarius, the sign of exploration, the two facing each other across the sky in opposition.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility stays in the sign of communication and the planet of expansion in the sign of exploration, facing each other across the sky.
rows.note: '서로 마주 보는 자리'=충(opposition)으로 보고 'facing each other across the sky'로 풀어씀

rows.ko: 사람들과 기술, 공동체의 모습이 깊은 곳에서부터 바뀌어 가는 긴 흐름입니다. 혼자보다 함께할 때 새로운 길이 열리기 쉬워요.
rows.en: A long cycle transforms people, technology, and communities from the ground up. Work alongside others rather than going it alone, and new paths open for you.
rows.en_before_tone: This is a long current in which people, technology, and communities are changing from deep within. New paths tend to open when you move together rather than alone.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 공동체와 미래의 별자리인 물병자리에 오래 머무는 시기예요.
rows.en: Pluto, the planet of rebirth, settles in for a long stay in Aquarius, the sign of community and the future.
rows.en_before_tone: A season when the planet of rebirth stays for a long time in Aquarius, the sign of community and the future.
rows.note: 원문 '깊은 변형의 별'(명왕성) → 글로서리의 the planet of rebirth로 통일

rows.ko: 나를 드러내는 일과 사람들 속의 나 사이에서 균형을 다시 잡는 해입니다. 그 과정에서 무엇이 시작되고 무엇이 마무리되는지 살펴보기 좋아요.
rows.en: This year, you find a new balance between shining on your own and showing up as part of the group. Watch closely: notice what begins and what draws to a close.
rows.en_before_tone: This is a year of finding a new balance between expressing yourself and being yourself among others. Along the way, it's worth noticing what begins and what comes to a close.

rows.ko: 해나 달이 가려지는 일식·월식이 사자자리와 물병자리를 잇는 축에서 이어지는 해예요.
rows.en: All year long, eclipses (moments when the Sun or Moon is briefly hidden) land on the Leo–Aquarius axis.
rows.en_before_tone: A year when eclipses, times when the Sun or Moon is briefly hidden, keep falling along the axis linking Leo and Aquarius.

A13.name: Q3 바람 × 판정 (이루어짐)
A13.used_in: 2027 마음가짐 판정 문단, 5년 표 '바람' 칸, 열리는 해

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 안정이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 집과 생활의 바탕이 한결 넓고 든든해지기 쉽습니다. 새로 벌이기보다 지금의 집·일·사람을 정돈할 때 이 흐름을 가장 잘 잡을 수 있어요. 다만 편안해졌다고 모든 것을 서둘러 굳히기보다 한 걸음씩 자리를 잡아 주세요.
rows.en: For stability, the coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, your home life grows roomier and more secure. Use this year well by putting your home, work, and relationships in order rather than starting something new. And even as life gets comfortable, don't rush to lock everything in: settle in one step at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: For stability, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind). With {{근거}}, the base of your home and life is likely to feel roomier and more secure. You can make the most of this flow by tidying up your current home, work, and relationships rather than starting new things. Still, even as things feel comfortable, there's no need to rush to lock everything in; you can settle in one step at a time.
rows.note: {{근거}}의 실제 형태(명사구/절)를 몰라 'With {{근거}},'로 통일. 근거 문구가 영어로 어떻게 나오는지 맞춰 조정 필요

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 생활의 바탕을 넓히기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · Build a sturdier home base
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year to widen the base of your life

rows.ko: 안정이라는 바람으로 보면 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 하늘이 어느 한쪽으로 크게 기울지 않아, 매일 무엇을 고르고 얼마나 꾸준히 지키느냐가 결과를 좌우해요. 잠드는 시간이나 장보는 요일처럼 바쁜 날에도 지킬 기준 하나를 먼저 정해 보세요.
rows.en: Stability sits in a Steady Year for you. The sky doesn't tip strongly either way, so your daily choices, and how faithfully you keep them, shape the outcome. Choose one anchor you'll keep even on hectic days, like a set bedtime or a regular grocery day.
rows.en_before_tone: Looking at your wish for stability, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). The sky doesn't lean strongly either way, so what you choose each day and how steadily you keep it up will shape the outcome. You might start by setting one standard you'll keep even on busy days, like a bedtime or a regular grocery day.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 작은 기준이 안정을 만드는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · Small anchors build your stability
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year small standards create stability

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 안정을 바로 얻기는 쉽지 않은, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. {{근거}} 때라 집과 생활을 지키는 책임이 무겁게 느껴지거나 일이 생각보다 더디게 풀리기 쉬워요. 모든 것을 지키려 하기보다 꼭 지킬 것 하나를 정하고 그 둘레부터 다지는 편이 좋습니다. 이렇게 다진 바탕은 쉽게 무너지지 않는 나만의 안정이 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, and stability takes patience to reach. With {{근거}}, looking after your home and life feels like a heavy load, and things move slower than you'd hoped. Don't try to hold everything at once: choose the one thing that matters most and build outward from there. A foundation laid this way becomes a steadfast stability that is truly yours.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when stability may not come right away. With {{근거}}, the responsibility of looking after your home and life may feel heavy, or things may move more slowly than you'd hoped. Rather than trying to protect everything, it can help to choose one thing you truly want to keep and build up around it first. The foundation you lay this way can become a stability of your own that doesn't crumble easily.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 지킬 것 하나를 단단히 하는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Secure the one thing that matters most
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to firm up the one thing you'll keep

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 안정이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 생활의 자리를 넓히기보다 뿌리를 내리는 쪽으로 힘을 쓰는 것이 좋습니다. 그 전까지 잠, 지출, 가까운 사람처럼 매일의 바탕을 하나씩 다져 두면 그 흐름을 더 오래 붙잡을 수 있어요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, {{근거}} brings the stability you've been hoping for within reach. That year, put down roots rather than spreading out. Until then, shore up the basics of daily life one by one (sleep, spending, the people closest to you) and you'll make that good stretch last.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the stability you've hoped for comes much closer. That year, it can help to put your energy into putting down roots rather than expanding your living space. Until then, if you firm up the basics of each day one by one, like sleep, spending, and the people close to you, you can hold on to that flow for longer.
rows.note: {{열리는해}}/{{가까운해}}는 연도(예: 2028)로 가정해 'In {{열리는해}}'로 처리

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 안정이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · Stability comes within reach
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year stability comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해 안에 안정이 활짝 열리는 해는 따로 보이지 않아, 하늘의 큰 도움보다 내가 쌓는 힘이 결과를 좌우합니다. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 안정이 가장 가까워지니, 그때를 바라보며 매일 지킬 작은 기준부터 쌓아 가 보세요.
rows.en: No clear Open Year for stability appears in the next five years, so the strength you build yourself counts for more than any boost from the sky. Stability comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Keep that year in sight and start with small daily anchors you can stick to.
rows.en_before_tone: There's no clear Wide-Open Year for stability in the next five years, so the strength you build matters more than big help from the sky. Of those years, stability comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so you might keep that year in view and start building small standards you can keep every day.

rows.ko: 도약을 바라는 당신에게 다가오는 해는 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 흐름이라 새 역할이나 도전에 문이 열리기 쉬워요. 미뤄 둔 제안이나 하고 싶던 일을 작은 형태로라도 먼저 꺼내 보면 이 흐름을 잡기 좋습니다. 다만 속도가 붙을수록 일정과 체력에는 여유를 넉넉히 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Hoping for a leap? The coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}} on your side, doors of opportunity open wide to new roles and challenges. Bring out the proposal you've been holding back, or try the thing you've wanted to do, even in a small way. As momentum builds, though, leave extra room in your schedule and your energy.
rows.en_before_tone: If you're hoping for a leap, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind). With {{근거}} in the flow, doors are likely to open to new roles and challenges. If you bring out a proposal you'd put off or something you've wanted to do, even in a small form, you can catch this flow well. Still, as things pick up speed, it's wise to leave plenty of room in your schedule and energy.

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 미뤄 둔 도전을 꺼내기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · Take on the challenge you've put off
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year to bring out challenges you'd put off

rows.ko: 도약이라는 바람에서 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)예요. 밀어주는 힘과 붙잡는 힘이 엇비슷해, 어디로 얼마나 뛸지는 내 선택과 꾸준함이 정합니다. 해 보고 싶은 일 하나를 정해 한 달에 한 번씩 작게 시도해 보는 것부터 시작해 보세요. 움직임이 많은 해라면 그 흐름이 도약을 거들어 줄 수도 있어요.
rows.en: For your wish to leap forward, the coming year is a Steady Year. The forces pushing you and holding you back are about even, so your choices and consistency decide where you jump and how far. Pick one thing you'd love to try and give it a small shot once a month. If the year turns out to be a Moving Year, that momentum adds lift to your leap.
rows.en_before_tone: For your wish to leap forward, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). The forces pushing you and holding you back are about even, so where and how far you jump comes down to your choices and consistency. You might start by choosing one thing you'd like to try and making a small attempt once a month. If it's a Moving Year, that flow may also give your leap a boost.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 내가 고른 방향이 길이 되는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · The direction you choose becomes your path
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year the direction you choose becomes your path

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 도약보다 발판을 마련하는, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. {{근거}} 때라 일과 역할의 책임이 무거워지고 결과가 기대보다 더디게 나오기 쉬워요. 지금은 실력과 준비물을 하나씩 채우고 뛸 때를 고르는 눈을 기르는 편이 좋습니다. 이 시기에 다진 발판이 다음 도약의 높이를 받쳐 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, made for building a launchpad rather than leaping. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities at work grow heavier, and results take longer to show than you'd like. Sharpen your skills, gather what you need, and train your eye for the right moment to jump. The launchpad you build now sets the height of your next leap.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), one for building a springboard rather than leaping. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities at work and in your roles may grow heavier, and results may come more slowly than you'd hoped. For now, it can help to build up your skills and preparations one by one and develop an eye for when to jump. The springboard you build in this season can support the height of your next leap.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 다음 도약의 발판을 다지는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Build the launchpad for your next leap
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to build the springboard for your next leap

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 도약이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 미뤄 두었던 도전이나 새 역할을 꺼내 보기 좋습니다. 그 전까지 실력과 포트폴리오, 함께할 사람을 차근차근 준비해 두면 열리는 문을 더 자신 있게 지나갈 수 있어요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the leap you've been hoping for moves within reach. That year, bring out the challenge or new role you've been holding back. Until then, get your skills, your portfolio, and your people in place, and you'll stride through that door with confidence when it opens.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the leap you've hoped for comes much closer. That year is a good time to bring out challenges or new roles you'd put off. Until then, if you prepare your skills, your portfolio, and the people you'll work with step by step, you can walk through that door with more confidence when it opens.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 도약이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · Your leap comes within reach
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year your leap comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해는 활짝 열리는 해보다 내가 쌓는 실력과 준비가 도약을 좌우하는 시기예요. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 도약이 가장 가까워지므로, 그때를 목표로 준비를 한 칸씩 쌓아 두면 좋습니다.
rows.en: Over the next five years, the skills and preparation you build shape your leap more than any Open Year could. Your leap comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Set your sights on that year and keep stacking up your preparation, one step at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: Over the next five years, the skills and preparation you build will shape your leap more than any Wide-Open Year. Of those years, your leap comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so it helps to aim for that year and build up your preparation one step at a time.

rows.ko: 회복을 바란다면, 다가오는 해는 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 무리하지 않아도 에너지가 조금씩 차오르기 쉽습니다. 일정 사이에 비워 둘 시간을 먼저 정해 두면 이 흐름을 잘 받을 수 있어요. 다만 기운이 돌아왔다고 바로 예전 속도를 내기보다 한 단계씩 올려 주세요.
rows.en: If recovery is your wish, the coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, your energy returns without you having to push. Block off open time between commitments first, and you make full use of this year. Once you feel like yourself again, build back up gradually instead of jumping straight to your old pace.
rows.en_before_tone: If you're hoping for recovery, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind). With {{근거}}, your energy is likely to fill back up little by little, even without pushing. If you set aside open time between your plans first, you'll be able to take in this flow well. Still, once your energy returns, there's no need to jump straight back to your old pace; you can raise it one step at a time.

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 에너지를 채우기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · A year to refill your energy
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year to recharge your energy

rows.ko: 회복은 다가오는 해에 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 돕는 흐름과 무게가 함께 있거나 어느 쪽도 크지 않아, 쉼을 얼마나 일정에 넣느냐가 회복의 속도를 좌우해요. 한 주에 하루, 아무 약속 없는 저녁을 먼저 달력에 적어 두는 것부터 해 보세요.
rows.en: Recovery sits in your own hands next year: a Steady Year. The supportive and heavy influences either balance out or stay mild, so the rest you actually build into your schedule sets your pace of recovery. Start tonight: mark one evening a week on your calendar with nothing planned.
rows.en_before_tone: For recovery, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). Supportive currents and weight are both present, or neither is strong, so how much rest you build into your schedule will set the pace of your recovery. You might start by marking one evening a week with no plans on your calendar.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 쉼을 일정에 넣는 만큼 채워지는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · The more rest you schedule, the more you refill
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year you refill as much as you make room for rest

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 회복이 더디게 느껴질 수 있는, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 쉬고 싶은 마음과 달리 할 일과 책임이 늘어나기 쉽습니다. 그래서 이 해에는 쉼을 남는 시간에 하는 일이 아니라 먼저 정해 두는 일로 다루는 편이 좋아요. 바쁜 와중에 지켜 낸 쉼의 습관은 그다음 해까지 이어지는 회복의 기초가 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, and recovery asks for patience. With {{근거}}, your to-do list and responsibilities keep growing even when all you want is rest. So treat rest as something you schedule first, never something you squeeze into leftover time. The rest habit you protect through a busy year becomes the foundation of a recovery that carries into the next.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when recovery may feel slow. With {{근거}}, your tasks and responsibilities may pile up even though you want to rest. So this year, it can help to treat rest not as something for leftover time but as something you schedule first. A rest habit you protect in the middle of a busy year can become the groundwork for recovery that carries into the next.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 쉼을 먼저 정해 두는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Put rest on the calendar first
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to schedule rest first

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 회복이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 일정과 마음에 여백을 넉넉히 두고 충전에 집중하기 좋습니다. 그 전까지 잠과 휴식의 리듬을 조금씩 지켜 두면 열리는 흐름을 더 깊이 누릴 수 있어요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the recovery you've been hoping for draws close. That year, leave generous room in your schedule and your mind, and make recharging your priority. Until then, guard your sleep and rest rhythms little by little, and you'll savor that easier stretch even more deeply.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the recovery you've hoped for comes much closer. That year, it's good to leave plenty of space in your schedule and your heart and focus on recharging. Until then, if you keep up a rhythm of sleep and rest little by little, you can enjoy that opening flow more deeply.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 회복이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · Recovery comes closest
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year recovery comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해 안에는 회복이 활짝 열리는 해가 뚜렷하지 않아, 내가 지키는 쉼의 습관이 회복을 좌우하는 시기입니다. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 회복이 가장 가까워지니, 그때까지 하루의 쉼을 작게라도 꾸준히 지켜 주세요.
rows.en: No clear Open Year for recovery appears in the next five years, so the rest habits you keep shape your recovery. It comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, protect a little rest every day, however small.
rows.en_before_tone: There's no clear Wide-Open Year for recovery in the next five years, so the rest habits you keep will shape your recovery. Of those years, recovery comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so until then, try to keep protecting a bit of rest each day, however small.

rows.ko: 사랑이라는 바람에서 다가오는 해는 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 때라 마음을 표현하고 받아들이는 일이 한결 자연스러워지기 쉬워요. 가까운 사람에게 고마움이나 좋아하는 마음을 먼저 말로 건네 보면 이 흐름을 잘 받을 수 있습니다. 다만 상대의 속도도 나만큼 소중하다는 것을 함께 기억해 주세요.
rows.en: For love, the coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, giving and receiving affection comes more naturally. Be the first to say thank you, or tell someone close how much they mean to you, and you make the most of this year. Just remember that their pace matters as much as yours.
rows.en_before_tone: For your wish for love, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind). With {{근거}}, expressing and receiving affection is likely to feel more natural. If you try being the first to say thank you or share your affection with someone close, you can take in this flow well. Still, it's worth remembering that the other person's pace matters as much as yours.

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 마음을 표현하기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · Say how you feel
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year to express your heart

rows.ko: 사랑에 대해 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)예요. 하늘의 저울이 어느 쪽으로도 크게 기울지 않아, 내가 마음을 얼마나 열어 두느냐가 관계의 온도를 좌우합니다. 내가 어떤 순간에 사랑받는다고 느끼는지 한 문장으로 적어 보는 것부터 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: In love, the coming year is a Steady Year. The cosmic scales don't tip strongly either way, so how open you keep your heart sets the warmth of your relationships. Write one sentence tonight about the moments when you feel most loved.
rows.en_before_tone: For love, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). The sky's scales don't tip strongly either way, so how open you keep your heart will set the warmth of your relationships. You might start by writing one sentence about the moments when you feel loved.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 마음을 여는 준비가 온도를 정하는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · Your openness sets the warmth
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year your readiness to open up sets the warmth

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 사랑이 마음먹은 대로 닿지 않는다고 느끼기 쉬운, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 관계에서 맡은 몫이 무겁게 느껴지거나 기대와 현실 사이의 거리가 더 크게 보일 수 있습니다. 지금은 관계의 속도를 재촉하기보다 내가 바라는 것과 지키고 싶은 것을 차분히 정리해 두는 편이 좋아요. 그 정리는 앞으로 마음을 나눌 때 나를 지켜 주는 단단한 기준이 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, and love doesn't always land the way you want it to. With {{근거}}, your role in relationships feels heavier, and the gap between hope and reality looks wider than usual. Rather than rushing a relationship, get clear on what you want and what you want to protect. That clarity becomes a steadfast set of standards that guards you whenever you open your heart.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when love may not seem to reach you the way you'd like. With {{근거}}, your part in relationships may feel heavy, or the gap between expectations and reality may look wider. For now, rather than hurrying a relationship along, it can help to calmly sort out what you want and what you want to protect. That clarity can become a solid standard that protects you when you share your heart in the future.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 내 마음의 기준을 정리하는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Get clear on what your heart needs
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to clarify what your heart needs

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 사랑이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 마음을 표현하고 다정함을 나누는 일이 한결 수월하게 느껴지기 쉽습니다. 그 전까지 나를 아끼는 방법과 관계에서 바라는 것을 차분히 알아 두면 그 흐름을 더 편안하게 맞을 수 있어요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the love you've been hoping for draws near. That year, expressing your feelings and sharing tenderness comes easily. Until then, learn how to care for yourself and what you truly want in a relationship, so you can welcome that year with an open heart.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the love you've hoped for comes much closer. That year, expressing your feelings and sharing tenderness may feel a lot easier. Until then, if you calmly get to know how to care for yourself and what you want in a relationship, you can welcome that flow more comfortably.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 사랑이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · Love comes closest
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year love comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해는 활짝 열리는 해보다 내가 마음을 여는 준비가 사랑을 좌우하는 시기예요. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 사랑이 가장 가까워지므로, 그때까지 나를 아끼는 연습과 마음을 표현하는 연습을 함께 쌓아 가면 좋습니다.
rows.en: Over the next five years, your readiness to open your heart shapes love more than any Open Year. Love comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, practice two things side by side: caring for yourself and saying how you feel.
rows.en_before_tone: Over the next five years, your readiness to open your heart will shape love more than any Wide-Open Year. Of those years, love comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so until then, it helps to practice both caring for yourself and expressing your feelings.

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 좋은 사람들과의 인연이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 모임이나 함께하는 일에서 마음 맞는 사람과 이어지기 쉽습니다. 가고 싶던 모임에 한 번 나가 보거나 오래 연락하지 못한 사람에게 먼저 안부를 건네 보세요. 다만 모든 자리에 다 가려 하기보다 나에게 맞는 자리를 골라 가는 것이 좋습니다.
rows.en: The coming year is an Open Year for meeting good people. With {{근거}}, groups and shared projects bring you kindred spirits you truly click with. Go to the meetup you've been curious about, or reach out first to someone you haven't talked to in a while. You don't have to show up to everything, though: choose the spaces that feel right for you.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for connecting with good people. With {{근거}}, you're likely to connect with like-minded people through groups or shared projects. You might try going to a gathering you've wanted to join, or being the first to check in with someone you haven't talked to in a while. Still, rather than trying to go to everything, it can help to choose the places that suit you.

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 먼저 안부를 건네기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · Reach out first
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year to reach out first

rows.ko: 사람과의 인연에서 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 하늘이 어느 한쪽으로 크게 기울지 않는 만큼, 내가 먼저 건네는 연락 하나가 관계의 모양을 좌우해요. 한 달에 한 사람, 고마운 사람에게 짧은 안부를 보내는 것부터 해 보세요.
rows.en: For your connections, the coming year is a Steady Year. The sky isn't tipping either way, so a single message you send first shapes what your relationships become. Begin with one quick note a month to someone you're grateful for.
rows.en_before_tone: For your connections with people, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). Since the sky doesn't lean strongly either way, a single message you send first can shape your relationships. You might start by sending a short hello each month to one person you're grateful for.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 먼저 건넨 연락이 관계를 만드는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · Reaching out first builds your circle
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year the first message you send builds relationships

rows.ko: 좋은 사람들을 바란다면, 다가오는 해는 관계를 넓히기보다 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 모임이나 공동체에서 맡을 책임이 늘거나 기대한 만큼 마음이 돌아오지 않는다고 느낄 수 있습니다. 지금은 이미 곁에 있는 몇 사람과의 연결을 깊게 하는 편이 좋아요. 이 시기를 지나며 오래 함께할 좋은 사람이 누구인지 더 또렷해지기도 합니다.
rows.en: If good people are your wish, the coming year is a Building Year, made for deepening your circle rather than widening it. With {{근거}}, you take on more responsibility in groups or communities, and the care you give doesn't always come back the way you'd hoped. Pour your energy into the few people already close to you. As you move through this season, you see clearly who's with you for the long haul.
rows.en_before_tone: If you're hoping for good people, the coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), better for deepening than widening your circle. With {{근거}}, you may take on more responsibility in groups or communities, or feel that care isn't returned as much as you'd hoped. For now, it can help to deepen your connection with the few people already beside you. As you go through this season, it may also become clearer which good people will stay for the long run.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 곁의 몇 사람을 깊게 하는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Go deeper with the few who are close
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to deepen ties with the few beside you

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 마음 맞는 사람들과 이어지기가 한층 수월해져요. 그해에는 새 모임이나 함께하는 일에 문을 열어 두기 좋습니다. 그 전까지 지금 곁에 있는 사람들과의 관계를 정성껏 가꿔 두면 좋은 인연이 머물 자리가 넉넉해져요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, {{근거}} makes finding your people far easier. That year, keep the door open to new groups and shared projects. Until then, tend the relationships you already have with real care, and good connections will find plenty of room to stay.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, connecting with like-minded people becomes much easier. That year, it's good to keep your door open to new groups and shared projects. Until then, if you care for your relationships with the people around you now, there can be plenty of room for good connections to stay.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 좋은 사람들과 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · You find your people
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year you grow closest to good people

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해 안에 좋은 인연이 활짝 열리는 해는 따로 보이지 않아, 내가 가꾸는 관계의 힘이 인연의 모양을 좌우하는 시기입니다. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 좋은 사람들과 가장 가까워지기 쉬우니, 그때까지 고마운 사람에게 먼저 안부를 건네는 습관을 이어 가 보세요.

rows.ko: 인정에서는 다가오는 해가 내 손에 달린 해(보통)예요. 밀어주는 힘과 붙잡는 힘이 엇비슷해, 내가 한 일을 어떻게 보여 주느냐가 결과를 좌우합니다. 한 주가 끝날 때 해낸 일 세 가지를 적어 두고, 필요할 때 꺼내 말해 보세요.
rows.en: For recognition, the coming year is a Steady Year. The push and pull are about even, so how you present your work shapes the outcome. At the end of each week, jot down three things you got done, and bring them up when the moment calls for it.
rows.en_before_tone: For recognition, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). The forces pushing you and holding you back are about even, so how you show your work will shape the outcome. At the end of each week, you might write down three things you accomplished and bring them up when needed.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 해낸 일을 보여 주는 만큼 돌아오는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · Show what you've done, and recognition follows
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year recognition returns as you show what you've done

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 애쓴 만큼 인정이 바로 돌아오지 않는다고 느끼기 쉬운, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 책임은 늘어나는데 눈에 보이는 보상은 더디게 느껴질 수 있습니다. 남의 평가를 기다리기보다 스스로 정한 기준으로 한 해의 성과를 기록해 두는 편이 좋아요. 이 시기에 쌓은 실력과 기록은 다음 기회에 나를 보여 주는 든든한 근거로 남습니다.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, when recognition lags behind your effort. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities grow while the visible rewards arrive slowly. Don't wait for others to judge your work: track the year's wins by your own standards. The skills and track record you build now speak for you when the next opportunity comes.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when recognition may not seem to come back as quickly as your effort deserves. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities may grow while visible rewards feel slow. Rather than waiting for others' evaluations, it can help to record your year's achievements by your own standards. The skills and records you build in this season can remain as solid evidence of what you can do when the next opportunity comes.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 스스로의 기준으로 기록하는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Track your wins by your own standards
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to keep records by your own standards

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 인정이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 그동안 쌓아 온 일을 드러내고 새 역할을 맡아 보기 좋습니다. 그 전까지 해낸 일을 꾸준히 기록해 두면 기회가 왔을 때 나를 더 자신 있게 보여 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the recognition you've been hoping for moves within reach. That year, put your work out there and step into new roles. Until then, keep a running record of what you've accomplished, so you can show what you're capable of with confidence when the chance comes.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the recognition you've hoped for comes much closer. That year is a good time to show the work you've built up and take on new roles. Until then, if you keep a steady record of what you've accomplished, you'll be able to show yourself with more confidence when the chance comes.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 인정이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · Recognition comes closest
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year recognition comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해 안에 인정이 활짝 열리는 해는 따로 보이지 않아, 내가 쌓는 실력과 기록이 인정을 좌우하는 시기예요. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 인정이 가장 가까워지므로, 그때를 바라보며 해낸 일을 하나씩 기록해 두면 좋습니다.
rows.en: No clear Open Year for recognition appears in the next five years, so the skills and track record you build are what earn it. Recognition comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Keep that year in sight and log your wins, one at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: There's no clear Wide-Open Year for recognition in the next five years, so the skills and records you build will shape your recognition. Of those years, recognition comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so it can help to keep that year in view and record what you accomplish, one thing at a time.

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 나답게 사는 길이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 때라 내가 좋아하는 것과 원하는 방향이 또렷해지기 쉬워요. 남의 기대보다 내 마음이 끌리는 선택을 하나씩 해 보면 이 흐름을 잘 잡을 수 있습니다. 다만 나다움을 찾는 과정에서 가까운 사람과 생각을 나누는 일도 함께 챙겨 주세요.
rows.en: The coming year is an Open Year for living as yourself. With {{근거}}, what you love and where you want to go come into sharp focus. Make one choice at a time based on what draws you, not what others expect, and this year works in your favor. As you discover what feels true, share your thoughts with the people close to you, too.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for living as yourself. With {{근거}}, what you love and the direction you want are likely to come into focus. If you make one choice at a time that your heart is drawn to rather than what others expect, you can catch this flow well. Still, as you search for what feels like you, it's worth making time to share your thoughts with the people close to you too.

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 내 방향이 또렷해지기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · Your direction comes into focus
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year for your direction to come into focus

rows.ko: 나다움의 바람에서 보면 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)예요. 하늘의 저울이 어느 쪽으로도 크게 기울지 않아, 작은 선택에서 내 마음을 얼마나 따르느냐가 결과를 좌우합니다. 이번 주에 남의 기준 말고 내 기준으로 고른 일 하나를 적어 보세요. 움직임이 많은 해라면 그 흐름도 나다움을 찾는 데 힘을 보태 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: Through the lens of being yourself, the coming year is a Steady Year. The cosmic scales don't tip strongly either way, so how closely you follow your heart in small choices shapes the outcome. This week, write down one thing you chose by your own standards instead of someone else's. If it's a Moving Year, that momentum helps you find your way back to yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: Looking at your wish to be yourself, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). The sky's scales don't tip strongly either way, so how much you follow your heart in small choices will shape the outcome. This week, you might write down one thing you chose by your own standards rather than someone else's. If it's a Moving Year, that flow can also help you find your way to being yourself.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 작은 선택이 나를 만드는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · Small choices make you who you are
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year small choices make you who you are

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 역할과 기대에 맞추느라 나다움을 지키기 어렵다고 느끼기 쉬운, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. {{근거}} 때라 해야 하는 일과 책임이 하고 싶은 일보다 앞서기 쉬워요. 하루 중 짧게라도 오롯이 나를 위한 시간을 지키고, 그 시간에 무엇이 즐거운지 살펴보는 편이 좋습니다. 무게를 견디며 지켜 낸 그 시간은 쉽게 꺾이지 않는 나만의 기준을 세워 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, when roles and expectations pull you away from yourself. With {{근거}}, what you have to do keeps coming before what you want to do. Protect a little time each day that's all yours, however brief, and notice what brings you joy in it. The time you guard while carrying that weight builds steadfast standards of your own.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when fitting into roles and expectations may make it hard to stay true to yourself. With {{근거}}, what you have to do and your responsibilities may come before what you want to do. It can help to protect some time each day that's fully yours, even briefly, and notice what brings you joy in it. Time you protect while carrying that weight can help you set standards of your own that don't bend easily.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 나만의 시간을 지키는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Guard the time that's yours
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to protect your own time

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 나다움이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 내 방식대로 일하고 사는 쪽을 골라 보기 좋습니다. 그 전까지 내가 언제 가장 나답다고 느끼는지 기록해 두면 그해의 선택이 한결 수월해져요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, living as yourself comes within reach. That year, choose to work and live on your own terms. Until then, note the moments when you feel most like yourself, and the choices of that year will come with ease.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the sense of being yourself that you've hoped for comes much closer. That year is a good time to choose to work and live in your own way. Until then, if you keep notes on when you feel most like yourself, that year's choices can feel much easier.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 나다움이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · Being yourself comes easiest
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year being yourself comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해는 활짝 열리는 해보다 내가 쌓는 선택의 기준이 나다움을 좌우하는 시기입니다. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 나다움이 가장 가까워지니, 그때까지 내 기준으로 고른 작은 선택을 하나씩 쌓아 가 보세요.
rows.en: Over the next five years, the standards you set for your own choices shape how true to yourself you live, more than any Open Year. Being yourself comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Until then, keep adding up small choices made by your own rules.
rows.en_before_tone: Over the next five years, the standards you build for your choices will shape how you live as yourself more than any Wide-Open Year. Of those years, being yourself comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so until then, try adding small choices made by your own standards, one at a time.

rows.ko: 새로운 시작을 꿈꾼다면, 다가오는 해는 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 새로운 배움이나 낯선 곳, 처음 해 보는 일에 문이 열리기 쉽습니다. 오래 마음에 두었던 시작 하나를 골라 첫 단계를 작게라도 밟아 보면 이 흐름을 잘 탈 수 있어요. 다만 설렘에 여러 일을 한꺼번에 벌이기보다 하나에 먼저 마음을 모아 주세요.
rows.en: Dreaming of a fresh start? The coming year is an Open Year. With {{근거}}, doors of opportunity open wide to new learning, new places, and things you've never tried. Choose one beginning you've been thinking about for a long time and take the first step, however small. In the excitement, though, focus on one thing first rather than launching everything at once.
rows.en_before_tone: If you're dreaming of a new start, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind). With {{근거}}, doors are likely to open to new learning, unfamiliar places, and things you've never tried. If you pick one beginning you've long held in your heart and take a first step, however small, you can ride this flow well. Still, rather than starting many things at once out of excitement, it can help to focus on one first.

rows.ko: 활짝 열리는 해(순풍) · 첫걸음을 내딛기 좋은 해
rows.en: Open Year · Take your first step
rows.en_before_tone: Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) · A good year to take your first step

rows.ko: 새로운 시작이라는 바람에서 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 돕는 흐름과 무게가 함께 있거나 어느 쪽도 크지 않아, 언제 어떻게 첫발을 떼느냐는 내 선택에 달려 있어요. 시작하고 싶은 일을 하나 정해 이번 달에 해 볼 가장 작은 첫 단계를 적어 보세요. 움직임이 많은 해라면 그 흐름이 새 출발에 힘을 실어 줄 수도 있습니다.
rows.en: For your wish for a new start, the coming year is a Steady Year. The supportive and heavy influences either balance out or stay mild, so when and how you take that first step is your call. Choose one thing you want to start and write down the smallest first step you can take this month. If it's a Moving Year, that momentum gives your fresh start a push.
rows.en_before_tone: For your wish for a new start, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). Supportive currents and weight are both present, or neither is strong, so when and how you take your first step is up to you. You might choose one thing you'd like to start and write down the smallest first step you could take this month. If it's a Moving Year, that flow may also give your fresh start a boost.

rows.ko: 내 손에 달린 해(보통) · 첫 단계를 내가 정하는 해
rows.en: Steady Year · You choose the first step
rows.en_before_tone: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) · A year you decide the first step

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 새로운 시작보다 준비에 힘이 실리는, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 시작하려는 일에 책임과 조건이 먼저 따라붙고, 일이 기대보다 더디게 풀리기 쉽습니다. 지금은 시작을 서두르기보다 필요한 배움과 준비를 차근차근 갖춰 두는 편이 좋아요. 이 시기에 다진 준비는 새 출발을 오래 이어 가게 하는 든든한 뿌리가 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, made for getting ready rather than starting fresh. With {{근거}}, whatever you want to begin arrives with responsibilities and strings attached, and things move slower than you'd like. Don't rush the start: line up the learning and preparation you need, step by step. The groundwork you lay now becomes the roots that keep your fresh start growing.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when energy goes into preparation more than new starts. With {{근거}}, responsibilities and conditions may come attached to what you want to begin, and things may move more slowly than you'd hoped. For now, rather than rushing to start, it can help to put the learning and preparation you need in place step by step. The preparation you lay in this season can become a sturdy root that helps your fresh start last.

rows.ko: 기반을 다지는 해(역풍) · 새 출발의 준비를 갖추는 해
rows.en: Building Year · Get ready for a fresh start
rows.en_before_tone: Groundwork Year (Headwind) · A year to get ready for a fresh start

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에는 {{근거}} 덕분에 바라던 새로운 시작이 한층 가까워져요. 그해에는 새로운 배움이나 낯선 곳, 처음 해 보는 일에 문을 열어 두기 좋습니다. 그 전까지 시작하고 싶은 일의 목록과 필요한 준비를 차근차근 갖춰 두면 열리는 흐름에 가볍게 올라탈 수 있어요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the fresh start you've been hoping for comes within reach. That year, keep the door open to new learning, new places, and first-time experiences. Until then, build a list of what you want to start and what you need to get there, and you'll step into that year with ease.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, thanks to {{근거}}, the new start you've hoped for comes much closer. That year, it's good to keep your door open to new learning, unfamiliar places, and things you've never tried. Until then, if you steadily build a list of what you want to start and the preparation you'll need, you can step lightly onto that opening flow.

rows.ko: 열리는 해 · 새로운 시작이 가장 가까워지는 해
rows.en: Open Year · A fresh start comes within reach
rows.en_before_tone: Opening year · The year a new start comes closest

rows.ko: 앞으로 다섯 해 안에 새로운 시작이 활짝 열리는 해는 따로 보이지 않아, 내가 갖추는 준비가 첫걸음을 좌우하는 시기입니다. 그중 {{가까운해}}에 새로운 시작이 가장 가까워지니, 그때를 바라보며 필요한 배움과 준비를 하나씩 쌓아 가 보세요.
rows.en: No clear Open Year for a new start appears in the next five years, so your preparation shapes your first step. A new start comes closest in {{가까운해}}. Keep that year in sight and build up the learning and preparation you need, one piece at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: There's no clear Wide-Open Year for a new start in the next five years, so the preparation you put in place will shape your first step. Of those years, a new start comes closest in {{가까운해}}, so you might keep that year in view and build up the learning and preparation you need, one piece at a time.

A13b.name: 바람 판정 표현 변형

rows.ko: 안정을 꿈꿔 왔다면 다가오는 해를 반갑게 맞아도 좋습니다. 이 해는 안정이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 흐름이라 머무는 자리와 하루의 리듬이 차분히 자리 잡기 쉽습니다. 오래 미뤄 둔 서랍 하나나 방 한쪽을 정리해 손 닿는 곳부터 편안하게 만들어 보세요.
rows.en: If you've been longing for stability, welcome the coming year with open arms: it's an Open Year for stability. With {{근거}} in play, your living space and daily rhythm settle gracefully into place. Start with that drawer or corner you've been putting off, and make the space within arm's reach feel like home.
rows.en_before_tone: If you've been dreaming of stability, you can welcome the coming year gladly. It's a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for stability. With {{근거}} in the flow, where you live and the rhythm of your days are likely to settle calmly into place. You might tidy up one drawer or corner of a room you've long put off, making the space within reach feel comfortable first.

rows.ko: {{근거}} 때라, 다가오는 해는 안정이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. 흩어져 있던 생활의 조각들이 제자리를 찾고, 마음 붙일 곳이 한결 또렷해지기 쉬워요. 이 흐름을 받으려면 한 주에 한 번 집에서 보내는 저녁을 정해 온전히 쉬어 보세요. 서두르지 않고 쌓은 편안함이 가장 오래 남습니다.
rows.en: With {{근거}}, the coming year is an Open Year for stability. The scattered pieces of your life fall into place, and you see clearly where you belong. To make the most of it, choose one evening a week to stay in and truly unwind. Comfort built without hurry is the kind that lasts.
rows.en_before_tone: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for stability. Scattered pieces of your life are likely to find their place, and where your heart belongs may become much clearer. To take in this flow, you might choose one evening a week to spend at home and rest completely. Comfort built without rushing is what lasts longest.

rows.ko: 집과 일상에 뿌리를 내리고 싶은 마음이 크다면, 다가오는 해는 안정이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 덕분에 기대고 쉴 수 있는 바탕이 넓어지기 쉬워요. 매일 아침 같은 시간에 일어나 같은 자리에서 차 한 잔을 마시는 작은 의식을 만들어 보세요. 그 반복이 안정을 몸으로 느끼게 해 주는 닻이 되어 줄 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Craving roots in your home and daily life? The coming year is an Open Year for stability. Thanks to {{근거}}, the ground you lean on and rest in grows wider. rows.ko: 도약을 바라 왔다면, 다가오는 해는 등 뒤에서 바람이 불어 주는 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 시기라 새로운 사람과 기회 사이를 잇는 다리가 놓이기 쉬워요. 내가 해 온 일을 한 장으로 정리해 가까운 동료나 선배에게 의견을 구해 보세요. 속도가 붙더라도 쉬는 날만큼은 먼저 지켜 두는 편이 오래 달리는 힘이 됩니다.
rows.en: If you've been hoping for a leap, the coming year is an Open Year, with the wind at your back. With {{근거}}, bridges form between you and new people and opportunities. rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 도약을 위한 판이 저절로 깔리기보다, 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 돕는 힘과 무게가 엇비슷해, 어떤 문을 두드리느냐에 따라 같은 해도 전혀 다르게 흘러가요. 가고 싶은 방향을 한 줄로 적고, 그 방향에 맞는 작은 배움 하나를 이번 계절 안에 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: In the coming year, the stage for your leap won't set itself: it's a Steady Year. Support and pressure run about even, so the same year plays out very differently depending on which doors you knock on. Write your direction in one line, and start one small bit of learning that fits it before the season is out.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), when the stage for a leap isn't simply set for you. rows.ko: 도약의 높이는 다가오는 해에 오롯이 내 선택을 따라가요. 하늘이 어느 쪽으로도 크게 쏠리지 않는, 내 손에 달린 해(보통)이기 때문입니다. 점심시간이나 퇴근길에 관심 분야의 글 한 편을 읽고 떠오른 생각을 메모로 남겨 두면, 쌓인 메모가 다음 발판이 되어 줘요. 움직임이 많은 해라면 그 흐름이 등을 살짝 밀어 줄 수도 있습니다.
rows.en: How high you leap in the coming year is entirely your choice. It's a Steady Year, and the sky isn't leaning hard either way. Read one article in your field over lunch or on your way home, and jot down the thoughts it sparks. Those notes pile up into your next stepping stone. If it's a Moving Year, that momentum gives you a nudge, too.
rows.en_before_tone: In the coming year, the height of your leap follows your own choices. That's because it's an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), when the sky doesn't lean strongly either way. rows.ko: 다가오는 해에 도약이 이루어질지는 하늘보다 나에게 더 많이 달려 있어요. 이 해는 밀어주는 쪽과 붙잡는 쪽이 엇비슷한 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 이 해에 꼭 해 보고 싶은 일 하나를 정해 함께해 줄 사람에게 미리 알려 두세요. 말로 꺼낸 목표는 혼자 품은 목표보다 한 걸음 더 빨리 움직이기 쉽습니다.

rows.en_before_tone: Whether a leap happens in the coming year depends more on you than on the sky. It's an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), when the push and the pull are about even. rows.ko: 어디까지 뛰어오를지는 다가오는 해에 내가 정하는 몫이 커요. 돕는 흐름과 무게가 함께 있거나 어느 쪽도 크지 않은 내 손에 달린 해(보통)라, 도약의 높이는 준비한 만큼 달라집니다. 지금 가진 강점 하나를 골라 그것을 보여 줄 작은 결과물을 만들어 보세요.

rows.en: You're dreaming of a leap, but the coming year is a Building Year, a time to steady the ground under your feet. rows.ko: {{근거}} 때라, 다가오는 해는 도약보다 버티며 실력을 쌓는 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. 맡은 일의 무게는 늘어나는데 성과가 바로 드러나지 않아 답답할 수 있어요. 한 달에 한 번, 그동안 배운 것과 해낸 것을 한 장에 정리해 스스로 확인해 보세요. 그 기록이 쌓일수록 다음 도약을 받칠 발판도 그만큼 높아집니다.

You might start by giving yourself a small gift that makes you feel good. The more you practice being kind to yourself, the wider the kindness in your relationships becomes.

rows.ko: {{근거}} 때라, 다가오는 해는 사랑에 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)로 읽힙니다. 곁에 있는 사람과의 대화가 깊어지고, 서로의 다른 점도 너그럽게 바라보기 쉬워요. 함께 걷는 산책이나 같이 차리는 밥상처럼 가까운 사람과 나누는 작은 의식을 하나 만들어 보세요. 다만 상대에게 같은 온도를 바라기보다, 내 마음을 편하게 표현하는 데 집중하는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: With {{근거}}, the coming year reads as an Open Year for love. Your conversations with the people close to you go deeper, and you meet your differences with an open heart. Create one small ritual to share with someone close, like a walk together or cooking a meal side by side. Don't ask them to match your intensity; focus on expressing your own feelings freely.
rows.en_before_tone: With {{근거}}, the coming year reads as a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for love. Conversations with the people beside you can deepen, and it gets easier to look at your differences with generosity. Try creating one small ritual to share with someone close, like a walk together or a meal you cook side by side. Still, rather than hoping the other person feels exactly as warmly as you do, it can help to focus on expressing your own feelings in a way that feels comfortable.

rows.ko: 설레는 마음으로 맞아도 좋을 다가오는 해는 사랑이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 흐름이라 다정한 말과 눈빛이 오가는 순간이 늘기 쉽습니다. 아끼는 사람과 함께 해 보고 싶었던 일 하나를 골라 가볍게 제안해 보세요. 함께 웃는 시간이 쌓일수록 관계의 온도도 한 뼘씩 올라갈 수 있어요.
rows.en: Greet the coming year with butterflies: it's an Open Year for love. With {{근거}}, sweet words and warm glances fill more of your moments. Choose one thing you've wanted to do with someone you care about and casually suggest it. The more you laugh together, the warmer things grow, little by little.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year, one you can greet with a fluttering heart, is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for love. With {{근거}}, moments of kind words and warm looks are likely to grow. You might pick one thing you've wanted to do with someone you care about and casually suggest it. As the times you laugh together add up, the warmth of the relationship can rise little by little.

rows.ko: 사랑이라는 바람 앞에서 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 돕는 힘과 무게가 엇비슷해, 내가 먼저 건네는 다정함이 관계의 결을 만들어 가요. 하루 한 번, 가까운 사람의 이야기를 끝까지 들어 주는 시간을 가져 보세요.
rows.en: For your wish for love, the coming year is a Steady Year. Support and pressure run about even, so the warmth you offer first shapes the feel of your relationships. Once a day, truly listen to someone close to you, all the way to the end.
rows.en_before_tone: For your wish for love, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). Support and weight are about even, so the kindness you offer first shapes the texture of your relationships. Once a day, try taking time to listen all the way through to someone close to you.

rows.ko: 사랑이 깊어질지는 다가오는 해에 하늘보다 내 마음가짐에 더 많이 달려 있어요. 어느 한쪽 힘이 앞서지 않는, 내 손에 달린 해(보통)이기 때문입니다. 관계에서 내가 지키고 싶은 것 하나와 내어 줄 수 있는 것 하나를 나란히 적어 보세요.
rows.en: In the coming year, your mindset shapes whether love deepens, more than the stars do. It's a Steady Year, with neither force taking the lead. Write down, side by side, one thing you want to protect in a relationship and one thing you're willing to give.
rows.en_before_tone: In the coming year, whether love deepens depends more on your mindset than on the sky. That's because it's an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), where neither force pulls ahead. Try writing down, side by side, one thing you want to protect in a relationship and one thing you can give.

rows.ko: 다가오는 해의 사랑은 내 손에 달린 해(보통)라는 말로 요약할 수 있어요. 흐름이 한쪽으로 쏠리지 않아, 작은 표현 하나가 관계의 온도를 바꾸기 쉽습니다. 이번 주에는 고마운 사람에게 ‘덕분에’라는 말을 한 번 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: Love in the coming year comes down to one phrase: Steady Year. The flow doesn't lean either way, so even one small gesture changes the warmth of a relationship. This week, say ‘I couldn't have done it without you’ to someone you're grateful for.
rows.en_before_tone: Love in the coming year can be summed up in one phrase: In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). The flow doesn't lean to one side, so a single small expression can easily change the warmth of a relationship. This week, try saying ‘thanks to you’ once to someone you're grateful for.
rows.note: ‘덕분에’ → ‘thanks to you’로 옮김

rows.ko: 사랑을 바라는 마음으로 보면, 다가오는 해는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)예요. 밀어주는 쪽과 붙잡는 쪽이 엇비슷해서, 나를 대하는 태도가 관계를 대하는 태도로 그대로 이어지기 쉽습니다. 거울 앞에서 나에게 다정한 말 한마디를 건네는 아침 습관부터 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: If love is your wish, the coming year is a Steady Year. The push and the pull are about even, so the way you treat yourself carries straight over into the way you treat your relationships. Start each morning by saying one kind thing to yourself in the mirror.
rows.en_before_tone: Seen through your wish for love, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady). What pushes you forward and what holds you back are about even, so the way you treat yourself tends to carry straight over into the way you treat your relationships. You might start with a morning habit of saying one kind thing to yourself in the mirror.

rows.ko: 사랑을 바라는 마음이 큰 만큼, 다가오는 해는 기다림이 길게 느껴질 수 있는 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. {{근거}} 시기라 관계 안에서 맡은 책임이 무겁거나, 마음을 나누기까지 시간이 더 걸리기 쉬워요. 서운한 마음이 들 때 바로 말하기보다 하루쯤 두었다가 차분한 문장으로 정리해 건네 보세요. 그렇게 다듬은 대화의 방식은 오래 가는 관계를 받치는 든든한 기둥이 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: Because you want love so deeply, the waiting feels long in the coming year, a Building Year. With {{근거}}, your responsibilities in a relationship weigh more, and truly opening up to each other takes time. When something hurts, let it rest for a day before you speak, then share it in calm, clear words. That way of talking things through becomes a sturdy pillar for a lasting relationship.
rows.en_before_tone: Because your wish for love runs deep, the coming year, a Groundwork Year (Headwind), may make the waiting feel long. With {{근거}}, the responsibilities you carry in a relationship may feel heavy, or it may take longer before you and someone else truly open up to each other. When you feel hurt, it can help to let it sit for a day instead of saying so right away, then share it in calm words. That way of shaping conversations becomes a sturdy pillar holding up a lasting relationship.

rows.ko: {{근거}} 때라, 다가오는 해는 사랑 앞에서 조금 더 신중해지는 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. 기대한 만큼 마음이 돌아오지 않는 것 같거나, 관계에 따르는 조건이 무겁게 느껴질 수 있습니다. 이 해에는 상대를 바꾸려 하기보다 관계에서 내가 편안한 거리와 속도를 살펴보는 편이 좋아요. 그렇게 알게 된 나의 속도는 앞으로 누구와 마음을 나누든 나를 지켜 주는 기준으로 남습니다.
rows.en: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Building Year, and you approach love with more care. Your feelings don't always come back as much as you'd hoped, and the strings attached to a relationship weigh on you. Don't try to change the other person; explore the distance and pace that feel right to you. Once you know your own pace, it guards you, whoever you open your heart to next.
rows.en_before_tone: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), when you become a little more careful about love. It may feel as if your feelings aren't returned as much as you hoped, or the conditions that come with a relationship may feel heavy. This year, rather than trying to change the other person, it may help to explore the distance and pace that feel comfortable to you. The pace you discover stays with you as a standard that protects you, whoever you share your heart with in the future.

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 사랑을 서두르기보다 다지는 쪽에 무게가 실리는, 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. {{근거}} 시기라 마음은 있어도 표현할 여유가 없거나, 관계의 일이 더디게 풀리기 쉬워요. 바쁜 주에도 아끼는 사람에게 짧은 안부 한 줄은 남기는 나만의 약속을 정해 보세요. 작은 약속을 지켜 온 시간은 관계를 오래 받쳐 주는 믿음의 바탕이 됩니다.
rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, more about strengthening love than rushing it. With {{근거}}, you have the feelings but not always the bandwidth to express them, and your relationship moves slowly. Make yourself a small promise: even in busy weeks, send at least a quick check-in to someone you care about. Promises kept over time build a foundation of trust that holds a relationship up for years.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind), with the weight falling on strengthening love rather than rushing it. With {{근거}}, you may have the feelings but not the room to express them, or relationship matters may unfold slowly. You might make yourself a small promise to send at least a short line checking in on someone you care about, even in busy weeks. Time spent keeping small promises becomes a foundation of trust that holds a relationship up for a long time.

rows.ko: 사랑에 관해서는 다가오는 해가 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)예요. {{근거}} 때라 관계 속 내 몫의 책임을 돌아보는 순간이 늘 수 있습니다. 혼자 있는 저녁에 ‘나는 어떤 사랑을 주고받고 싶은가’를 세 문장으로 적어 보세요. 이 해에 또렷해진 그 문장들이 앞으로의 관계에서 길잡이가 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: In love, the coming year is a Building Year. With {{근거}}, you reflect more on your own share of the responsibility in a relationship. On a quiet evening alone, write three sentences on ‘what kind of love do I want to give and receive?’ The answers that come clear this year guide your relationships from here on.
rows.en_before_tone: When it comes to love, the coming year is a Groundwork Year (Headwind). With {{근거}}, there may be more moments of reflecting on your share of responsibility in a relationship. On an evening alone, try writing three sentences about ‘what kind of love do I want to give and receive?’ The sentences that become clear this year can serve as a guide in your future relationships.

rows.ko: 바라던 사랑은 {{열리는해}}에 한결 따뜻하게 다가오기 쉬워요. {{근거}} 흐름이라 그해에는 마음을 표현하고 받아들이는 일이 자연스러워지기 좋습니다. 그때까지 나를 기쁘게 하는 것들을 하나씩 알아 가면, 열린 흐름 속에서 나다운 방식으로 사랑을 나누기 쉬워져요.
rows.en: The love you've been hoping for arrives with new warmth in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, expressing and receiving feelings comes naturally that year. Until then, discover the things that make you happy, one by one, and you'll share love in your own way when that time comes.
rows.en_before_tone: The love you've hoped for is likely to come more warmly in {{열리는해}}. With {{근거}}, expressing and receiving feelings is likely to come more naturally that year. Until then, if you get to know the things that bring you joy one by one, it will be easier to share love in your own way within that open flow.

rows.ko: {{근거}} 시기인 {{열리는해}}에는 관계 안의 다정함이 한층 깊어지기 쉽습니다. 그해에는 마음을 아끼지 말고 표현해 보기 좋아요. 그 전까지 감정을 솔직하게 말로 옮기는 연습을 일상 대화에서 조금씩 해 두면 그해의 표현이 한결 편안해져요.
rows.en: In {{열리는해}}, a time of {{근거}}, the tenderness in your relationships deepens. That year, say how you feel without holding back. Before then, practice putting your feelings into honest words in everyday conversation, and opening up will feel easy when the moment comes.
rows.en_before_tone: In {{열리는해}}, a time of {{근거}}, the tenderness in your relationships is likely to deepen. That year is a good time to express your feelings without holding back. Before then, if you practice putting your feelings honestly into words in everyday conversations, expressing yourself that year will feel much easier.

rows.ko: {{열리는해}}에 이르면 {{근거}} 덕분에 사랑을 주고받는 마음에 순한 바람이 붑니다. 그해에는 관계의 속도를 내 마음에 맞춰 천천히 키워 가기 좋아요. 그때를 기다리며 혼자서도 즐거운 하루를 꾸리는 법을 익혀 두면, 그해의 사랑이 더 건강하게 자랄 수 있어요.
rows.en: Once {{열리는해}} arrives, thanks to {{근거}}, a gentle breeze blows over giving and receiving love. That year, let a relationship grow slowly, at a pace that feels right to you. While you wait, learn how to make a day joyful on your own, and that year's love grows on healthier ground.
rows.en_before_tone: When {{열리는해}} arrives, thanks to {{근거}}, a gentle breeze blows over the giving and receiving of love. That year is a good time to let a relationship grow slowly, at a pace that suits your heart. While you wait, if you learn how to make a day enjoyable even on your own, that year's love can grow in a healthier way.

rows.ko: 앞으로의 흐름에서 {{열리는해}}에는 사랑에 가장 넉넉한 볕이 듭니다. {{근거}} 때라 그해에는 아끼는 사람과의 거리가 한결 가까워지기 쉬워요. 그 전까지 서운함을 말하는 나만의 부드러운 방법을 찾아 두면 그 볕을 더 오래 누릴 수 있습니다.
rows.en: In the years ahead, {{열리는해}} is when love basks in the most sunshine. With {{근거}}, that year draws you closer to the people you care about. Before then, find your own gentle way of saying when something hurts, and you'll enjoy that sunshine for longer.
rows.en_before_tone: In the flow ahead, {{열리는해}} brings the most generous sunlight to love. With {{근거}}, that year is likely to bring you closer to the people you care about. Before then, if you find your own gentle way of saying when you feel hurt, you'll be able to enjoy that sunlight for longer.

rows.ko: 다섯 해 안에 사랑이 활짝 열리는 해는 따로 보이지 않아, 내가 마음을 가꾸는 방식이 관계의 온도를 정하는 시기예요. {{가까운해}}에는 흐름이 사랑 쪽으로 조금 더 기우니, 그때까지 고마움을 표현하는 습관을 천천히 길러 가면 좋습니다.
rows.en: No year in the next five stands out as an Open Year for love, so the way you tend your heart sets the warmth of your relationships. The flow tilts a little toward love in {{가까운해}}. Until then, build a habit of showing gratitude.
rows.en_before_tone: No year in the next five stands out as a Wide-Open Year for love, so the way you tend your heart sets the warmth of your relationships. In {{가까운해}}, the flow tilts a little more toward love, so until then it helps to slowly build a habit of expressing gratitude.

rows.ko: {{가까운해}}에 사랑이 가장 가까워지지만, 앞으로 다섯 해 안에 활짝 열리는 해는 뚜렷하지 않습니다. 그래서 하늘의 바람보다 나를 다정하게 대하는 연습이 사랑을 맞을 자리를 넓혀 줘요.
rows.en: Love comes closest in {{가까운해}}, though no clear Open Year appears in the next five years. So, more than any wind from the sky, your kindness toward yourself makes room for love to arrive.
rows.en_before_tone: Love comes closest in {{가까운해}}, but no clear Wide-Open Year appears in the next five years. So, more than any wind from the sky, practicing kindness toward yourself widens the space where love can arrive.

rows.ko: 이어질 다섯 해는 순풍을 기다리기보다 관계의 뿌리를 천천히 키우는 시기입니다. {{가까운해}}에 사랑의 흐름이 가장 순해지니, 그때까지 아끼는 사람들과 작은 약속을 지키는 경험을 쌓아 가 보세요.
rows.en: The next five years invite you to grow deep roots in your relationships rather than wait for a tailwind. Love flows most gently in {{가까운해}}. Until then, build a track record of keeping small promises with the people you care about.
rows.en_before_tone: The next five years are a time to slowly grow the roots of your relationships rather than wait for a tailwind. The flow of love is gentlest in {{가까운해}}, so until then, try keeping small promises with the people you care about, one at a time.

rows.ko: 다섯 해를 내다봐도 사랑에 순풍이 크게 부는 해는 보이지 않아, 내가 여는 마음의 크기가 더 중요해요. {{가까운해}}에는 그 마음이 닿기 한결 쉬워지니, 그때까지 서운함과 고마움을 모두 부드럽게 말하는 연습을 해 두면 좋습니다.
rows.en: Looking five years out, no year brings a strong tailwind for love, so how open your heart is matters more. In {{가까운해}}, your feelings reach others more easily. Until then, practice gently voicing both hurt and gratitude.
rows.en_before_tone: Looking ahead five years, no year shows a strong tailwind for love, so how wide you open your heart matters more. In {{가까운해}}, your feelings reach others more easily, so it helps to practice gently voicing both hurt and gratitude until then.

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 좋은 사람들이 곁으로 모이기 쉬운, 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 흐름이라 함께 배우고 어울리는 자리에서 마음 맞는 사람을 알아보기 쉬워요. 관심 있는 주제의 소모임이나 원데이 수업에 한 번 신청해 보세요. 처음 만난 자리에서 다 친해지려 하기보다 한 사람과 깊게 이야기 나누는 쪽이 오래 남습니다.
rows.en: The coming year is an Open Year, and good people gather around you. With {{근거}} in play, you spot kindred spirits wherever you learn and spend time together. Sign up for a small group or a one-day class on something that interests you. Don't try to befriend everyone the first time; one real conversation with one person stays with you longer.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind), when good people tend to gather around you. With {{근거}}, it's easier to recognize kindred spirits in places where you learn and spend time together. You might try signing up for a small group or a one-day class on a topic that interests you. Rather than trying to befriend everyone at a first meeting, having a deep conversation with one person tends to stay with you longer.

rows.ko: {{근거}} 때라, 다가오는 해는 좋은 사람들과의 연결이 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. 오래된 관계는 더 따뜻해지고, 새로 알게 된 사람과도 편안하게 이어지기 쉽습니다. 고마웠던 사람 한 명을 떠올려 밥 한 끼나 차 한 잔을 먼저 청해 보세요. 다만 모든 부탁에 응하기보다 내 시간을 아끼는 선도 함께 지키는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: With {{근거}}, the coming year is an Open Year for connecting with good people. Old friendships grow warmer, and new ones click with ease. Think of one person you're grateful to and invite them out for a meal or coffee first. Still, you don't have to say yes to every request: keep a boundary that protects your time.
rows.en_before_tone: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for connecting with good people. Old relationships can grow warmer, and new acquaintances can connect with you comfortably. You might think of one person you've been grateful to and be the first to invite them for a meal or a cup of tea. rows.en_before_tone: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for the foundation of financial ease. Instead of vague worry about money, standards that fit your life are likely to become clearer. You might start a ‘save first’ habit: on the day income comes in, set aside the portion you'll save before anything else. Still, as your standards take shape, leaving a share for small pleasures for yourself helps the habit last.

rows.ko: 경제적 여유를 꿈꾼다면 다가오는 해는 생활의 기반을 다듬기 좋은 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)입니다. {{근거}} 덕분에 지출과 저축의 리듬을 내 생활에 맞게 조율하기 쉬워요. 한 주 동안 쓴 돈을 영수증이나 앱으로 모아 주말에 오 분만 돌아보는 시간을 가져 보세요. 흐름이 좋을수록 큰 결정은 바로 내리기보다 한 번 더 기준에 비춰 보는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: If financial ease is your dream, the coming year is an Open Year, a fine time to refine the basics of everyday life. With {{근거}} on your side, you find a spending-and-saving rhythm that suits you. Gather a week's spending from receipts or an app, and give it five minutes of review on the weekend. And the better things flow, the more it pays to hold big decisions up to your rules once more before you leap.
rows.en_before_tone: If you dream of financial ease, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind), good for refining the foundation of your daily life. Thanks to {{근거}}, it's easier to tune your rhythm of spending and saving to fit your life. Try gathering what you spent over a week, through receipts or an app, and taking just five minutes on the weekend to look back on it. The better the flow, the wiser it is to check big decisions against your standards once more rather than making them on the spot.

rows.ko: 경제적 여유라는 바람에서 보면, 다가오는 해는 생활의 기준을 세우기에 활짝 열리는 해(순풍)예요. {{근거}} 시기라 돈을 대하는 태도가 한결 차분해지고, 필요한 것과 원하는 것을 구분하기 쉬워집니다. 한 달에 한 번 ‘돈을 쓰고 가장 좋았던 일’과 ‘아쉬웠던 일’을 하나씩 적어 보세요.
rows.en: Viewed through your wish for financial ease, the coming year is an Open Year for setting your own money rules. Because of {{근거}}, you meet money with a calmer mind and tell needs from wants more easily. Once a month, write down your ‘best money spent’ and your ‘money I wish I'd kept.’
rows.en_before_tone: Seen through your wish for financial ease, the coming year is a Wide-Open Year (Tailwind) for setting standards for your life. With {{근거}}, your attitude toward money is likely to grow calmer, and it gets easier to tell needs from wants. Once a month, try writing down one ‘best thing I spent money on’ and one ‘thing I regret spending on.’

rows.ko: 다가오는 해는 경제적 여유를 위한 기반이 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 돕는 힘과 무게가 엇비슷해, 매달 반복되는 지출 습관이 생활의 넉넉함을 정하기 쉬워요. 장보기 전에 살 것을 미리 적고 그 목록 안에서만 고르는 연습부터 해 보세요.
rows.en: On the financial-ease front, the coming year is a Steady Year. The support and the weight balance out, so the spending habits you repeat each month decide how comfortable life feels. Begin with one simple practice: write a list before you shop, and buy only what's on it.
rows.en_before_tone: The coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady) for building the foundation of financial ease. Support and weight are about even, so the spending habits you repeat each month tend to decide how comfortable life feels. You might start by writing a shopping list before you go and choosing only from that list.

rows.ko: 경제적 여유를 바란다면, 이 해는 돈의 흐름을 얼마나 들여다보느냐가 결과를 정하는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)예요. 하늘이 어느 쪽으로도 크게 기울지 않아, 막연한 걱정보다 구체적인 기준 하나가 더 큰 힘이 됩니다. 한 달에 한 번 날을 정해 고정 지출과 남은 몫을 한 장에 적어 보세요.
rows.en: If financial ease is what you want, this is a Steady Year, and your results follow how closely you watch where your money goes. The sky leans neither way, so one concrete rule serves you better than any amount of worry. Choose one day a month to put your fixed costs and what's left over on a single page.
rows.en_before_tone: If you want financial ease, this is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), when the outcome depends on how closely you look at where your money goes. The sky doesn't lean strongly either way, so one concrete standard is stronger than vague worry. You might pick a day once a month to write your fixed expenses and what's left on a single page.

rows.ko: 다가오는 해에 경제적 여유를 향한 걸음은 내가 정한 기준을 따라 움직여요. 어느 한쪽 힘도 앞서지 않는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)라, 작은 지출 습관이 쌓여 차이를 만듭니다. 배달이나 충동구매처럼 자주 새는 지출 하나를 골라 한 달 동안 횟수를 줄여 보세요.
rows.en: Your path to financial ease in the coming year follows the rules you set. It's a Steady Year, and with neither side outweighing the other, small spending habits add up to a real difference. Pick one regular money leak, like food delivery or impulse buys, and cut back on it for a month.
rows.en_before_tone: In the coming year, your steps toward financial ease follow the standards you set. This is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), where neither force pulls ahead, so small spending habits add up to make a difference. Try picking one frequent leak, like food delivery or impulse buys, and cutting back on it for a month.

rows.ko: 돈 앞에서 넉넉한 마음을 갖고 싶다면, 다가오는 해는 경제적 여유의 바탕을 내가 직접 다지는 내 손에 달린 해(보통)입니다. 밀어주는 쪽과 붙잡는 쪽이 엇비슷해, 기준을 지킨 달과 놓친 달의 차이가 쌓여 가기 쉬워요. 갑작스러운 일에 쓸 몫을 작게라도 따로 떼어 두는 통장이나 봉투를 하나 마련해 보세요.
rows.en: If you want to feel at ease around money, the coming year is a Steady Year, and the foundation for financial ease is yours to build. The push and the pull run even, so the gap between months you keep your rules and months you don't widens over time. Open one savings account or envelope just for surprises, even if you start small.
rows.en_before_tone: If you want to feel at ease around money, the coming year is an In-Your-Hands Year (Steady), when you lay the groundwork for financial ease yourself. What pushes you forward and what holds you back are about even, so the difference between months you keep your standards and months you don't tends to add up. You might set up one account or envelope to put aside even a small amount for unexpected things.

rows.en: The coming year is a Building Year, when carrying everyday responsibilities asks more of you than enjoying financial ease. With {{근거}}, fixed costs and the share you cover feel heavy. rows.ko: {{근거}} 때라, 다가오는 해는 돈 앞에서 조건과 책임을 먼저 따져야 하는, 경제적 여유의 기반을 다지는 해(역풍)입니다. 계획대로 모이지 않는 것 같아 답답한 달이 있을 수 있어요. 그럴 때 스스로를 탓하기보다, 이번 달 지킨 기준 하나를 찾아 적어 보세요. 무게를 견디며 지켜 낸 기준들은 이후 경제적 여유를 받쳐 줄 생활의 바닥이 됩니다.
rows.en: With {{근거}}, the coming year is a Building Year for financial ease, when you weigh obligations and conditions before anything else.
